ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have 2-4 years of hands-on accounting experience and proficiency in Sage Intacct and SAP Concur. A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred, along with strong analytical and organizational skills.
description_text:
Position: Accounting Specialist
Classification: Full-time, salaried employee
Location: U.S. Remote
Compensation: $50,000-$60,000 base salary
About Stratoscope
At Stratoscope, we create peace of mind for our clients through operational excellence, professionalism, and precision. We are a global leader in event operations, crowd management, and public safety, supporting major events worldwide — from Fortune 100 conferences and tech summits to global sporting and entertainment events.
Our mission is to deliver secure, seamless, and positive event experiences by blending strategic planning, elite personnel, and innovative solutions. Stratoscope contractors are the face of this mission, embodying our commitment to trust, professionalism, and the pursuit of greatness.
The Accounting Specialist is a hands-on member of the Stratoscope Holdings Finance & Accounting team responsible for accurate day-to-day accounting execution across multiple legal entities. The position supports a lean, highly automated accounting function and has primary responsibility for accounts payable, accounts receivable and project billing, cash application, bank reconciliations, employee and contractor expense processing, assigned monthly account reconciliations, and month-end close support. 
This role is intended for an accounting professional with a solid accounting foundation and practical experience who can independently manage routine accounting activities, identify and research discrepancies, maintain complete supporting documentation, and escalate matters requiring judgment. The Accounting Manager and Controller retain responsibility for complex journal entries, technical accounting, final close ownership, and financial statement review.
Hands-on Sage Intacct experience and SAP Concur experience are required. The Accounting Specialist will work in both systems as part of the regular accounting workflow.
Core Responsibilities
Accounts Payable
Enter, code, review, and process vendor and contractor invoices, including validation of the correct legal entity, project, department, general ledger account, payment terms, approvals, and supporting documentation.
Research duplicate invoices, credits, missing documentation, coding inconsistencies, and other exceptions before transactions are processed.
Maintain accurate vendor records, support W-9 collection and validation, respond to routine vendor inquiries, and assist with annual 1099 preparation and corrections.
Prepare approved transactions for payment processing in accordance with company controls and established payment schedules.
Accounts Receivable & Project Billing
Review contracts, statements of work, billing schedules, project budgets, purchase orders, deposits, change orders, billable expenses, pass-through costs, and other supporting documentation required for customer invoicing.
Prepare, review, input, and post customer and project invoices in Sage Intacct, including deposit, progress, recurring, milestone, and final invoices.
Validate legal entity, customer, project, billing terms, rates, revenue items, reimbursable expenses, and other billable activity prior to invoice release.
Monitor billing completeness, identify delivered work that has not been invoiced, follow up on missing support, process routine invoice corrections or reissues, and assist with collection follow-up as assigned.
Cash Receipts & Bank Reconciliations
Record and apply customer payments to open receivables and research unapplied or unidentified cash receipts.
Prepare monthly bank reconciliations for assigned accounts, including matching receipts and disbursements to the general ledger and researching outstanding checks, deposits, transfers, or other reconciling items.
Ensure reconciling differences are documented and resolved or escalated in a timely manner.
Account Reconciliations & Month-End Close Support
Prepare assigned monthly account reconciliations for lower- to moderate-complexity balance sheet and operating accounts, including AP, AR, clearing accounts, prepaid expenses, deposits, advances, cash-related accounts, and other accounts assigned by the Accounting Manager or Controller.
Maintain complete reconciliation support that clearly explains the account balance, reconciling items, and required follow-up.
Complete assigned month-end close activities, including transaction cutoffs, billing completeness, AP and expense completeness, reconciliation schedules, account research, and supporting documentation.
Prepare routine recurring schedules and simple journal-entry support for review by the Accounting Manager.
Expense Management
Review employee and contractor expense reports in SAP Concur for receipts, business purpose, policy compliance, entity, project, reimbursable status, and general ledger coding.
Return incomplete or improperly coded submissions for correction, monitor approval flow, and help ensure approved expense activity is accurately reflected in Sage Intacct.
Research routine Concur posting or transaction exceptions and escalate system-level or configuration issues with clear documentation.
Accounting Systems, Master Data & Documentation
Perform daily accounting activities in Sage Intacct and SAP Concur and maintain accurate vendor, customer, project, and transaction data.
Support new vendor and customer setup, required documentation, billing terms, and purchase-order requirements.
Research routine transaction and integration exceptions, correct items within the scope of the role, and escalate configuration or system issues rather than creating unsupported manual workarounds.
Maintain complete invoice, approval, reconciliation, expense, and payment documentation in accordance with company procedures and internal controls.
Provide transaction support and schedules for audits, tax work, and internal reviews, and maintain current procedures for recurring accounting activities.
2-4 years of hands-on accounting experience, including accounts payable, accounts receivable or billing, bank reconciliations, and month-end accounting support.
Hands-on Sage Intacct experience is required. Candidates should be able to navigate the system and process routine accounting transactions without training on basic system functionality.
Hands-on SAP Concur experience is required, including expense report review, receipts, coding, approval workflows, corrections, and downstream accounting impact.
Working knowledge of debits and credits, general ledger coding, accrual accounting, transaction cutoff, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and the purpose of balance sheet reconciliations.
Demonstrated experience preparing bank and account reconciliations and researching reconciling differences through resolution.
Experience coding transactions across departments, projects, locations, or legal entities.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, lookups, filters, pivot tables, and reconciliation schedules.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to independently research routine discrepancies before escalation.
Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to work effectively with Finance, Operations, employees, contractors, customers, and vendors.
Associate or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant accounting experience will be considered.
Preferred Qualifications
Multi-entity accounting experience.
Project-based, professional-services, event, security, or other operations-focused accounting experience.
Bill.com experience, including invoice processing, approval workflows, payment support, or sync exception research.
Experience supporting 1099 reporting and vendor compliance.
Exposure to project profitability, job-cost accounting, or project-based billing.
Experience working in an automated accounting environment and supporting practical process improvements.
Core Competencies
Accounting Accuracy. Produces complete, well-supported accounting work and understands how transactions affect the general ledger.
Ownership & Follow-Through. Takes responsibility for assigned activities from initiation through resolution and maintains visibility to unresolved items.
Analytical Problem Solving. Researches discrepancies before escalating and communicates the issue, findings, and recommended next step.
Organization & Deadline Management. Maintains control of recurring accounting responsibilities and consistently meets processing and close deadlines.
Communication. Communicates clearly and professionally with accounting and non-accounting stakeholders.
Continuous Improvement. Identifies practical opportunities to improve accuracy, reduce manual work, and strengthen accounting processes and controls.
The Accounting Specialist is responsible for accurate execution and preparation of assigned accounting activities. The position is expected to resolve routine issues independently and escalate unusual, complex, or judgmental matters. Complex journal entries, technical accounting conclusions, final financial statement review, and ownership of the monthly close remain with the Accounting Manager and Controller.

description_text:
Position Summary: We are seeking a Corporate Tax Accountant to facilitate tax
compliance and internal functions related to corporate and state and local tax
(SALT). This position will be responsible for preparing state and local sales
tax and other tax returns (i.e. WA B&O Tax) on a recuring basis across various
Hoffman entities, ensuring compliance through self-auditing across state and
local jurisdictions and preparing and managing property tax compliance. In
addition, this role will include research and detail-oriented review of
financial records, with a strong emphasis on construction industry-specific tax
regulations including percentage-of-completion accounting, multi-state nexus,
and job costing considerations. The Corporate Tax Accountant will work closely
with the Corporate Tax Manager to ensure all SALT tax matters are addressed.
While this role will focus on SALT related items, this role will also have
exposure to other tax areas such as federal income tax, cost-segregation and
more. The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented tax professional with
experience in the construction industry across varying jurisdictions in the
Western United States. This position will be fully on site in the Lake Oswego,
OR main office.

 

Salary Range: $75,000 - $95,000 DOE

 

Essential Responsibilities:

 * Prepare sales & use tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
 * Prepare and manage property tax returns annually.
 * Ensure compliance with multi-state tax regulations and nexus requirements.
 * Prepare apportionment workpapers for income tax and review state and local
   income tax returns.
 * Collaborating with tax advisors on SALT issues.
 * Prepare correspondence and responses to state and local tax authorities.
 * Analyze, monitor, and pursue legislative, regulatory, and judicial state tax
   developments.
 * Collaborate across multiple departments to ensure various taxes and taxable
   costs are captured accurately in job cost and owner billings.
 * Other activities, duties, and responsibilities as assigned.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience and Education:

 * High School Diploma or GED required.
 * Bachelor’s degree in accounting from an accredited and credentialed degree
   program.
 * 1-2 Years Public Accounting Experience with a large regional or Big 4
   accounting firm or 3-4 years within a similar industry state and local tax
   role.
 * Experience in indirect state and local tax compliance and preparation.
 * Experience in a similar role with a large specialty and/or general
   contractor.
 * Experience working in a multi-entity and intercompany corporate structure.
 * Advanced Excel skillset.
 * Experience working in accounting software Oracle JD Edwards Enterprise One or
   another tier-one ERP solution.

 

Position Related Skills:

 * Must have proficient working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, MS
   Teams, etc. and be able to work well within a network environment.
 * Keen analytic ability to review, assess and interpret trends of large
   quantities of disparate financial data required.
 * Able to maintain confidential information and adhere to company financial
   policies, practices, and standard operating procedures.
 * Exercise independent judgment and discretion related to all business and
   people matters.
 * Must be detail oriented and be able to identify issues or inaccuracies.
 * Must have critical thinking abilities.
 * Must be able to function in a deadline-oriented environment.
 * Must be able to work multiple tasks and between a variety of departments.
 * Must be a strong team player, self-starter, flexible and be able to work well
   with a variety of personalities, with minimal direct supervision.

 

Physical and Mental Requirements:

 * Standing/Walking/Sitting: workday is combination of standing, walking and
   sitting.
 * Must be able to climb stairs: 5% of day.
 * Hands/Arms: constant use of hands/fingers for mouse/keyboard/computer use.
 * Sight: visual acuity in near, mid and far range vision. Color vision,
   peripheral vision, depth perception, hand/eye coordination.
 * Hearing: sufficient to hear conversational levels in person and over the
   telephone.
 * Speech: sufficient to make oneself heard in person, speak in front of groups,
   and be understood over the telephone.
 * Bending/Twisting/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: minimal.
 * Constant mental alertness, accuracy, and attention to detail required.
 * Must be able to work independently, make decisions, and follow through on all
   assignments.
 * Must use independent judgment, organizational and problem-solving skills to
   determine best method to accomplish desired results.
 * Must be able to plan and organize work.
 * Must possess strong organizational and computer use skills and have a high
   level of competency to read/write/speak English and communicate with
   coworkers.

description_text:
Overview

Position Title: Accounts Payable Manager
Department: Accounting / Purchasing 
Reports To: Accounts Payable Director 
Status: Exempt/ Full Time
Location: Corporate Office (Bensalem, PA)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Accounts Payable Manager manages all activities without the Accounts Payable Department. The Manager provides direction and guidance to the Accounts Payable Supervisors and Administrators processing timely vendor invoices, vendor payments, credit card processes, expense vouchers while maintaining accurate records and control reports. The Accounts Payable Manager prepares purchase journals, spend analysis reports for various internal and external departments, and ad hoc reports as requested. Coordinates training to administrators on accounts payable and the program/purchasing teams. 
The Accounts Payable Manager we are hiring, will be joining a dynamic and team-oriented department who is looking for someone to make an immediate impact. The Manager ensures that projects/ department goals are met and processes are effectively followed. Must have extensive knowledge of the A/P department and Vendor processes. Individuals must be extremely trustworthy as they will have access to confidential information on a daily basis. 
Position Summary

Ensure all internal control procedures are understood by the team and they are performed as required.
Oversee administration Expense reporting software, including reporting and accounts reconciliations.
Reviews and analyzes vendor invoices and weekly/monthly spend to track out of periods or missed transactions. 
Must communicate & follow up effectively with all vendors and Employees on a timely basis.
Review vendor statements and reconcile missed invoices and identify discrepancies and credits. 
Reviews and codes vendor invoices to ensure correct coding and their timely processing
Manage AP Settlements from multiple checking account, process, reconciliations, and reporting.
Must be familiar with digital vendor files (W-9) and 1099 processes

Reviews cash disbursements and approves settlements for Banking ACH/EFT, Checks, Bank wires and Credit cards if needed

description_text:
Company Summary
Hampton Lumber is a thriving family-owned company aspiring to be North America's preferred source for responsibly-sourced wood solutions. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, we operate ten sawmills across Oregon, Washington, South Carolina, and British Columbia. We also manage timberland and operate a wholesale and import/export division. 
Our mission is to grow, manufacture, and market renewable wood products and deliver innovative solutions for a more sustainable built environment. At Hampton Lumber, we accomplish this through our own operations as well as those of our affiliates—Trapa Forest Products, Idaho Timber, and RedBuilt. Our motto, "Find a better way every day," encapsulates our commitment to innovation and improvement across all operations. 
We are guided by our core values: 
Safety – Prioritize safety across all operations.
Integrity & Authenticity – Operate honestly and ethically while preserving our distinctive family-owned brand.
Responsible Stewardship – Endeavor to balance and maintain economic, social, and environmental values in everything we do.
Tenacity – Embrace challenges with grit, determination, and a can-do spirit. 
Continuous Improvement – Strive to enhance our processes, products, and people.
Customer Satisfaction – Be nimble, responsive, and solutions-oriented.
Community Engagement – Be a responsive, supportive, and respected member of the community.
With over 80 years in the sawmill business, we are proud to have cultivated the knowledge and experience needed to grow and prosper, even in challenging times. We always look to the future and invest in our people, new technologies, and continuous improvement processes and techniques. 
Overview
Hampton Lumber is seeking a Treasury Analyst to join our team in Portland, Oregon. This position will report directly to the Assistant Treasurer. In this role the ideal candidate will be responsible for day-to-day treasury functions of the Company. This includes achieving optimal cash management of Company funds among its U.S. and Canadian subsidiaries and interfacing with banking partners and internal parties to ensure cash activities are completed efficiently, and Company assets are protected. 
The Treasury Analyst will assist in the administration of Company retirement plans including regular internal compliance activities, coordination with plan recordkeeper, and assistance with external audit and communication with plan participants. The Treasury Analyst will assist in the Company’s risk management activities and insurance programs, including interfacing with the Company’s insurance brokers on renewal, claims and coverage matters, managing requests for certificates of insurance, and other related projects. This position provides exposure to multiple operational areas of the business and is an ideal role for individuals seeking the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic finance and treasury function.
Benefits Highlights
Substantial company-paid assistance for Medical and Dental insurance premiums; mental health coverage; cost effective co-pays and deductibles
401(k) with 5% annual company contribution and generous company matching contributions vested over three years
Paid time off, including eight paid holidays
Opportunity to earn bonuses
Employee wellness program that includes free counseling sessions, financial and legal guidance, and more
Opportunities for paid training to support career advancement and personal development
Responsibilities
Ensure the Company’s daily cash management activities are effectively and efficiently looked after. This involves cash positioning across several deposit and investment accounts of various domestic and Canadian subsidiaries and utilization of intercompany notes and revolving lines of credit to ensure appropriate daily liquidity for the Company’s subsidiaries.
Monitor Company’s foreign currency hedge portfolio, evaluating alternative strategies as markets change and executing trades in collaboration with the Assistant Treasurer.
Support positive relationships with Company banking and insurance partners.
Work on treasury management improvement projects such as migration to electronic payments or utilization of other FinTech opportunities.
Support fiduciary responsibilities for Company employee benefit plans. This will include performing regular compliance tests in conjunction with the payroll & benefits departments, responding to inquiries from participants and recordkeeper on plan considerations for participant transactions, and supporting the execution of the external plan audit.
Support the Company’s risk management and insurance programs, including coverage considerations, policy renewals, insurance certificate management, claims administration, etc.
Additional projects and/or responsibilities based on capacity and proficiencies.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, preferably with an Accounting or Finance emphasis.
1-3 years of accounting or finance experience is preferred, ideally within a manufacturing environment or with exposure to corporate finance and/or treasury functions; however, recent graduates with relevant education, internships, or coursework are encouraged to apply.
Familiarity with defined contribution plan concepts and transaction types a plus.
Exposure to foreign currency hedging concepts and strategies.
Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Good organizational and communication skills plus the ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines. Strong work ethic, sense of commitment, team-oriented, customer focused and willingness to embrace change while striving for continuous improvement.
Assertive and responsible, exemplifying the highest level of ethics, honesty, and integrity. Highly motivated to learn new skills and grow professionally.
Able to take on additional responsibilities and interested in advancement.
More About Us
Hampton Lumber is a fourth-generation, family-owned company headquartered in Portland, Oregon that has grown to become one of the nation’s largest privately held forest products companies. With over 80 years in the sawmill business, Hampton operates sawmills in Oregon, Washington, and British Columbia and markets wood products all over the world. We also manage a wholesale and lumber export division and numerous reload and re-manufacturing facilities throughout the U.S. All of Hampton’s forestlands are certified by the Sustainable Forestry Initiative (SFI), an independent, non-profit organization that promotes sustainable forest management. SFI certified forests play an important role in water conservation, wildlife habitat, and climate solutions. 
Community is important to us, and we encourage and support our employees’ desire to be active in the community through volunteering and special projects. We passionately support youth education, career and technical education, the arts, diversity and inclusion, affordable housing, and anti-poverty programs. We are also proud sponsors of the Portland Timbers and the Portland Thorns soccer clubs. Go Timbers! Go Thorns!
Learn more at hamptonlumber.com, or follow us on Facebook: @HamptonLumber. You can also learn about our company and our priorities by visiting our blog. 
EEO Statement
Hampton Lumber is an equal opportunity employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by law. 
Disability accommodation available: If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation in the application or hiring process, please contact the Human Resources Office for the location that you are applying.
Women and minorities are encouraged to apply.
For more information about our commitment to equal employment opportunity, please see these government posters: EEO is the Law and its accompanying temporary supplement.

description_text:
Airport Services Financial Analyst (Remote)

Do you understand airport ground handling operations and enjoy working with
numbers?

Grupo EULEN is looking for a Financial Analyst who can bridge the gap between
airport operations, workforce planning, and financial analysis.

This is not your traditional Financial Analyst position.

We are particularly interested in professionals who understand how a ground
handling operation actually runs—whether your background is in Operations
Management, workforce planning, resource planning, or aviation finance and who
can translate operational activity into the staffing and costs needed to
successfully operate an account.

If you understand flight schedules, staffing requirements, productivity,
operational hours, and headcount—and you're strong with Excel—we can help you
develop the pricing and proposal side of the business.

What you'll be doing:

 * Analyze operational hours, flight schedules, and workload data from INFORM.
 * Convert operational hours into realistic headcount and staffing requirements.
 * Build staffing assumptions around shift coverage, supervision, productivity,
   schedules, and days of operation.
 * Analyze staffing requirements across services including Ramp, Cabin Cleaning,
   Passenger Services, Baggage, GSE, and other ground handling operations.
 * Use Excel to analyze operational data, staffing requirements, labor costs,
   and financial assumptions.
 * Support cost models incorporating labor, supervision, equipment, supplies,
   and overhead.
 * Partner directly with Operations, Finance, Sales, and Pricing leadership.
 * Support aviation RFPs, bids, pricing exercises, and new business proposals.
 * Help validate staffing models after contract awards to ensure what was
   proposed can actually work operationally.
 * Who we're looking for:
 * We're open to candidates coming from different career paths.

 

You could currently be an:

✈️ Airport Operations Manager
✈️ Ground Handling Manager or Supervisor
✈️ Workforce or Resource Planning Analyst
✈️ Aviation Financial/Pricing Analyst
✈️ INFORM or Workforce Planning Specialist

What matters most is that you understand ground handling operations and how
operational workload translates into people, hours, and cost.

Key qualifications:

 * Ground handling or airport operations experience.
 * Experience with INFORM or comparable workforce/resource planning systems
   strongly preferred.
 * Strong Excel and analytical skills.
 * Ability to translate operational hours into staffing/headcount requirements.
 * Understanding of aviation staffing, productivity, schedules, and operational
   coverage.
 * Comfortable working with both operational and financial data.
 * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain the story behind the
   numbers.
 * Experience with RFPs, contracts, pricing, or financial modeling is a plus,
   but it is not required.
 * A bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Aviation Management, or
   a related field is preferred; however, relevant aviation ground handling
   experience will absolutely be considered.

 

Work Arrangement

Candidates near our Miami/Doral office may work on a hybrid schedule.

Remote candidates may also be considered if working from an eligible state. Due
to current business requirements, remote candidates cannot be based in New York,
Florida, Maryland, Virginia, or Washington.

 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Grupo EULEN is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants without
regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity,
sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age,
disability, citizenship, military service, genetic information, or any other
characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Description
Job Overview:
The Staff Accountant supports the organization’s day-to-day accounting operations, including cash receipts processing and reconciliation, revenue reconciliation, accounts receivable, invoicing, bank reconciliations, and month-end close activities. This role works closely with internal teams to ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded, reconciled, and maintained in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities independently while contributing to a collaborative accounting team. This position is currently on-site with work from home flexibility.

Role and Responsibilities: 
Daily bank review and reconciliations between membership batches and applicable credit card entries.
Distributes ACH banking deposits to appropriate staff including maintaining and updating daily cash log.
Prepares and reconciles daily cash reports – including daily uploads of membership batches to MIP.
Assists in the monthly financial close process and maintaining the general ledger.
Monthly invoicing of program underwriters and special events – including management of event and underwriting programs software and working with underwriting and event staff. 
Helps prepare monthly revenue reconciliations between development donor database and the general ledger. 
Assists in company audits, gathers necessary information and documents for on-time completion.
Performs general accounting and other related duties for the organization as assigned.
Assists in reconciling company bank accounts monthly.
Scans and deposits major giving donation checks mailed to our office. 
Assists in managing accounts receivable collections.
Maintains knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles.
Requirements

Education and/or Experience: 
Accounting degree or related field required
At least two years of related experience required, non-profit experience a plus
MIP software experience a plus 
Skills & Knowledge:
Understanding of and the ability to adhere to generally accepted accounting principles
Proficient in Google mail, docs, drive, and relevant accounting software
Proficient in Microsoft Excel
Competent in required job skills and knowledge
Exhibits ability to learn and apply new skills
Requires minimal supervision
Prioritizes and plans work activities
Uses time efficiently & plans for additional resources
Balances team and individual responsibilities
Contributes to building a positive team spirit

description_text:
About Druva
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.

Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
The Role & Team

The FP&A team is responsible for providing data-driven insights to inform strategic, financial, and operational decision-making across Druva. We are looking for a highly strategic and hands-on Finance Manager of GTM Finance to amplify Druva’s capabilities and growth trajectory. You will be reporting to the Sr Director of GTM Finance and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive strategy, execution, and process excellence. You will drive deep dive data analytics and strategic projects. Your efforts will directly contribute to operational efficiency, expense management, and customer satisfaction. This role will partner closely with the CRO, CMO, CFO, and GTM leadership teams to translate business strategy into financial plans, operating models, and actionable insights.
What You’ll Do
Strategic Business Partnership: Partner with the CRO, CMO, and GTM leadership to translate business strategy into financial plans, provide actionable insights, and drive resource allocation and business decisions.
GTM Financial Management: Own Sales and Marketing Opex, headcount, T&E, and commission forecasting. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and BvA processes to drive financial accountability and operational efficiency. Act as an advisor to CRO on resource allocation, investment prioritization and financial discipline.
Sales Capacity: Own sales capacity models. Analyze the impact of hiring, attrition, ramp, and productivity on ACV targets and sales performance.
Sales ROI & Economics: Build fully loaded P&L and ROI models for sales theaters, incorporating direct, overlay expense and indirect costs to evaluate sales effectiveness and investment returns.
Marketing Pipeline & ROI: Partner with Marketing to manage pipeline-to-bookings models, establish pipeline targets, and evaluate the ROI of programs, campaigns, and MDF investments.
Strategic Planning & Automation: Lead long-range planning, GTM strategy, scenario analysis, and other strategic initiatives. Continuously improve financial models and leverage AI and automation to streamline reporting, forecasting, and analysis.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Build trusted relationships across Sales, Marketing, Operations, HR and Finance to drive strategic planning and business performance.
What Makes You a Great Fit
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field (MBA or CFA strongly preferred).
5+ years of experience in Finance, with at least 3 years supporting GTM teams in a SaaS environment.
Strong understanding of SaaS financial and operational metrics is a plus (ARR, churn, CAC, NRR, sales efficiency, quota attainment, commission, ROI, Pipeline).
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills; you can influence at all levels
Experience with financial planning tools (Adaptive, Dashboard, SQL), Salesforce CRM, Clari and data analytics platforms. Fast learner on AI tools.
Exceptional modeling skills and the ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable insights. Details oriented. 
Ownership mindset — An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action. You are proactive, solution-oriented, and take accountability for outcomes.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on. 
If you’re looking for high-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.
What We Offer
The pay range for this position is expected to be between $139,000 and $194,333/year; however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized, non-discriminatory factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus or commissions, and equity. Additionally, full-time employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits program, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) retirement plan, life and disability insurance coverages, and other benefits the Company may offer from time to time. 
Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates:
For information on personal data processing, please see our Druva Privacy Policy
Druva is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us at recruiting_us@druva.com

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
ai_core_responsibilities: The Accounts Receivable Specialist manages client accounts, submits invoices through electronic portals, and performs collection tasks. They also research and resolve invoicing issues while collaborating with project management to meet client requirements.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have an Associate degree or two years of experience in accounts receivable or customer service. Proficiency in basic computer skills, verbal and written communication, and the ability to work in the United States are required.
description_text:
Company Description
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.
Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.
Job Description
The Accounts Receivable Specialist will interact with internal and external clients on a daily basis, submitting invoices to electronic invoice portals, monitoring assigned client accounts and performing collection tasks as needed, analyzing and processing requests in a timely manner with little or no supervision; solving problems and answering questions; assessing situations and initiating a course of action.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Applies GMP/GLP in all areas of responsibility, as appropriate
Demonstrates and promotes the company vision
Regular attendance and punctuality
Research and respond to client requests (internal/external) in a clear, concise, and professional manner
Serve as main invoicing contact for all clients using electronic invoicing portals.
Monitor an assigned list of client accounts and perform collection tasks as required
Work with project management to review and implement client requirements for electronic invoicing
Upload invoices to client billing systems as needed
Address invoicing issues directly with client and follow-up with client until issue is resolved
Work on special projects as requested
Attends meetings within the lab
Conducts all activities in a safe and efficient manner
Performs other duties as assigned
This position is M-F, 8am-5pm. 
Qualifications
Basic Minimum Qualifications:
Associate Degree in business or related discipline or two years experience in accounts receivables or customer service
Basic computer skills including typing 
Ability to communicate verbally and in writing 
Authorization to work in the United States without restriction or sponsorship 
Ideal Candidates will have:
Bachelors degree in related field, preferred
Previous experience with accounts receivables and customer service
Experience with credit cards and collections
Excel knowledge and general math skills
Ability to work independently and with a group 
Problem-solving skills
Additional Information
Pay rate: $19.00-22/hour 
Please note - Eurofins Environment Testing (USA) provides a compensation range for informational purposes, the actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience and skill set, base salary of internal peers, business sector, and geographic location.
As a Eurofins employee, you will become part of a company that has received national recognition as a great place to work. We offer excellent full-time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, paid time off, and dental and vision options.
*The benefits package offered will vary based on the employee’s full-time or part-time regular status.
We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.
We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
Sustainability matters to us! At Eurofins, we believe sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Guided by our vision to be the Global Leader in “Testing for Life,” our mission to contribute to a healthier and safer world, and our core values, we are building a strong foundation for Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Eurofins’ commitment to sustainability begins within our own companies through a shared responsibility to people and the planet. With climate change posing an imminent threat, Eurofins and its many companies recognize their duty to proactively reduce or offset the environmental impact of essential operations while also helping our clients do the same—serving as a true ESG Enabler.
Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/ 
The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and Eurofins Scientific agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 
In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 
In 2025, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 7.296 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Eurofins USA Environment Testing is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Compensation: USD 19.00 - USD 22.00 - hourly

title: Accountant
ai_core_responsibilities: The accountant is responsible for recording and producing financial statements, including managing journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and bank reconciliations. They also assist in process improvements, audit support, and ad-hoc financial reporting for assigned business units.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have a bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance and 1-3 years of related experience. Proficiency in Excel and knowledge of automated accounting systems are required.
description_text:
What Will I be Doing?

The accountant will be responsible for accounting functions associated with the
recording and production of financial statements for assigned business units.
Perform the assigned functions related to configurations, posting and interface
functions impacting the financial statements, including general accounting,
payable, payroll and fixed asset. Assist the Manager in providing accounting
support to various shared services departments.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Here’s why you will love it here:

 * Recognition Programs and Rewards
 * Excellent health care options, including medical, dental, and vision
 * A people-first culture
 * Go Hilton: Travel Discounts Program Hilton hotel rates worldwide.
 * Perks at work: Employee Pricing platform
 * Employee Assistance Program that supports your physical and mental
   well-being.
 * Paid Vacation Time and Paid Sick Days
 * 401(k) program with company match
 * Tuition reimbursement programs
 * Numerous learning and advancement opportunities
 * And more!

 

 

Position Summary: 

 * Prepare and review journal entries per established policy related to assigned
   entities
 * Perform accounting functions as applicable such as funding tax escrow
   accounts, paying property taxes and tangible taxes and reporting tangible
   taxes
 * Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations related to assigned
   entities. Determine correcting entries for reconciling items
 * Review team member journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations as
   assigned
 * Record journal entries to clear outstanding items
 * Review financial statements before distribution to the Manager for integrity
   and accuracy
 * Create and post journal entries, analyze financial results, ensure that all
   deadlines are met and all deliverables are completed with a high-quality
   product. 
 * Review bank reconciliations associated with assigned business units and
   record journal entries to clear outstanding items  
 * Assist the Manager in improving efficiencies by evaluating processes and
   procedures to maximize accuracy of financial statements
 * Verify that data presented is accurate and complete.
 * Document processes and procedures for the assigned functions 
 * Perform ad-hoc reporting, analysis, and modeling as requested. 
 * Perform special projects as requested by management
 * Assists co-team members and internal customers with financial information
 * Assists auditors with year-end reporting.     
 * Always provides highest quality of service to customers and staff.
 * Work effectively with team members within accounting and across departments
   to effect changes and complete special projects required as part of
   company-wide goals and objectives. 


QUALIFICATIONS

 

Required Qualifications: 

 * Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/Finance
 * 1-3 years of related experience
 * Knowledge of automated accounting systems.
 * Proficient in Excel

title: Corporate FP&A Manager
ai_core_responsibilities: The Corporate FP&A Manager will lead annual department budgets, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning while serving as a finance partner to department leaders. They will also manage procurement workflows, SaaS spend tracking, and implement financial planning tools to support business growth.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have 5+ years of FP&A or business finance experience with direct ownership of headcount and operating expense planning. Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, and experience with planning systems like Pigment or Anaplan is required.
description_text:
About Snorkel
Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. We combine technology with research-driven AI data development to create datasets, benchmarks, evals, and custom solutions for real-world AI systems. Founded out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019, Snorkel works with leading AI labs and enterprises to move from better data to better outcomes. 

Excited to help us redefine how AI is built? Apply to be the newest Snorkeler!
The Role
The Corporate FP&A Manager will own headcount and operating expense planning across Snorkel and serve as the finance partner to department leaders. You will turn hiring and spending plans into reliable forecasts, help teams make investment decisions and build better cost visibility. You will also manage Ramp and procurement workflows and implement planning tools as the business grows.
Key Responsibilities
Lead annual department budgets and rolling forecasts for headcount and non-headcount expenses, aligning spending with company growth and profitability targets.
Own the headcount and personnel cost model with People and Recruiting, reflecting hiring plans, attrition, compensation and benefits.
Partner with department leaders on hiring and investment decisions, identifying cost savings and evaluating tradeoffs in growth, capacity and profitability.
Partner with Accounting on month-end close, including expense accruals, and lead headcount and OpEx variance analysis against budget and forecast.
Own SaaS and vendor spend tracking, the purchase order system and procurement approvals, working with Legal, IT and Accounting on purchases and renewals.
Own and manage Ramp, including spend programs, company cards, approval workflows and expense policies, in partnership with Accounting.
Implement and administer planning tools such as Pigment or Anaplan and improve data integrations, reporting and planning processes.
Partner with the Senior FP&A Manager to prepare consolidated financial reporting, with clear commentary on spending trends and outlook for executive reviews and board materials.
About You
5+ years of FP&A or business finance experience, including direct ownership of headcount and operating expense planning in a growing technology company.
Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills and experience building models that connect hiring, vendor commitments and operating drivers to financial forecasts.
Hands-on experience managing Ramp, including spend approvals, expense controls and reporting.
Experience implementing and administering planning systems such as Pigment, Anaplan or similar platforms, including financial model design and data integrations.
Strong understanding of expense accruals, cost allocation and financial statements, with a record of partnering effectively with Accounting.
Ability to build relationships with department leaders, explain financial tradeoffs clearly and turn analysis into recommendations.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to establish practical processes, improve data quality and follow through across multiple workstreams.
Experience with SaaS or AI businesses, IT, cloud or inference costs, and contractor or services delivery economics is a plus.
Why This Role
This role is an opportunity to build the cost planning and spend management foundation of a growing AI company. You will help leaders make better hiring and investment decisions and translate operational improvements into stronger financial performance.
Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.
Salary range(s) for this role
$125,000—$180,000 USD
Be Your Best at Snorkel
Joining Snorkel AI means becoming part of a company that has market proven solutions, robust funding, and is scaling rapidly—offering a unique combination of stability and the excitement of high growth. As a member of our team, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to shape priorities and initiatives, influence key strategic decisions, and directly impact our ongoing success. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise, explore leadership opportunities, or learn new skills across multiple functions, you’re fully supported in building your career in an environment designed for growth, learning, and shared success.
Snorkel AI is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Snorkel AI embraces diversity and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. Snorkel AI prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, performance, merit, and business need.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Accounting Consultant
ai_core_responsibilities: The Accounting Consultant supports core accounting functions including general ledger activities, financial analysis, and reporting to ensure GAAP compliance. They are responsible for leading monthly closing activities, managing revenue recognition, and maintaining internal controls.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting and at least 3 years of experience in accounting, including month-end close and reconciliations. Proficiency in GAAP and strong organizational skills are required, with CPA designation and healthcare experience preferred.
description_text:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 
The Accounting Consultant is a mid-level finance professional responsible for supporting core accounting functions, including general ledger activities, financial analysis, and reporting. This role ensures accuracy, compliance with GAAP, and supports financial close and audit processes.
You’ll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely * from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.
Primary Responsibilities:
The Accounting Consultant will support Optum Insight by:
Serve as a trusted accounting partner to business leaders, finance teams, and cross-functional stakeholders
Lead monthly closing activities for assigned products or business areas, including full P&L and balance sheet ownership
Maintain general ledger accounts and prepare journal entries, including revenue, expense, and other required accruals, in accordance with GAAP and company policies
Perform account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and resolve complex accounting and financial reporting issues
Own or support revenue recognition and billing processes, including evaluating unique or complex arrangements
Analyze monthly financial results and prepare clear P&L and balance sheet variance commentary
Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close and financial reporting activities, including preparation or review of financial statements and supporting schedules
Develop, document, implement, and maintain effective accounting processes, procedures, and internal controls
Identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of accounting processes and reporting
Manage multiple priorities independently and collaborate with team members to ensure accurate and timely deliverables
You’ll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.


Required Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Accounting including a solid understanding of GAAP and financial statement interaction
3+ years of Accounting experience including month-end close, preparation of journal entries and account reconciliations
Proven to be a self-starter and solid time management
Proven to be organized and able to work on multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
Proven solid communication and interpersonal skills
Proven to anticipate customer needs and proactively develops solutions to meet them
Preferred Qualifications:
CPA designation
Experience with Peoplesoft Financials, Hyperion SmartView and Blackline
Public accounting experience
Technical accounting experience, including ASC606
Healthcare experience
*All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group’s Telecommuter Policy
Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you’ll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $72,800 - $130,000 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

description_text:
Charleston Metro Chamber of Commerce
 Controller

Division: Finance

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer (COO)

Direct Reports: Financial Analyst; Director of Grant Compliance

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Charleston, SC

Revised: October 2026


POSITION SUMMARY

The Controller is the Chamber’s senior accounting and financial planning & analysis leader and a key partner to the COO in developing and executing the Chamber’s finance strategy. The role is responsible for building and leading a scalable internal Finance function while ensuring the integrity of financial reporting, month-end and year-end close, forecasting and analysis, cash-flow forecasting and liquidity oversight, internal controls, nonprofit and grant accounting, audit readiness, and finance-team development. Leading the Financial Analyst and Director of Grant Compliance, the Controller will play a central role in transitioning accounting from an outsourced model to an internal operating structure, implementing and optimizing modern finance technology, including responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities, and establishing stronger forecasting, analytics, cash-management, and Board-reporting capabilities. The Controller is accountable for the quality and effectiveness of the Finance function while appropriately delegating transactional, preparer, and analytical work across the team.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


ACCOUNTING, CLOSE & FINANCIAL REPORTING

• Own the monthly and year-end close process and ensure timely, accurate financial statements and management reporting across entities, funds, departments, programs, grants, and projects/events.

• Maintain general-ledger integrity and appropriate accounting under GAAP and nonprofit standards, including ASC 958, revenue recognition, receivables, deferred revenue, contributions, grants, and restrictions.

• Review and approve journal entries and reconciliations prepared by the Financial Analyst; divide balance-sheet reconciliations with the Analyst based on complexity, risk, workload, development opportunities, and segregation of duties.

• Oversee intercompany accounting, allocations, working-capital accounts, payroll accounting, and other significant or judgmental accounting matters.


FINANCIAL PLANNING, ANALYSIS & EXECUTIVE REPORTING

• Lead monthly management reporting, budget-to-actual analysis, monthly reforecasting, annual budget mechanics, and forward-looking financial analysis.

• Own the rolling cash-flow forecast and liquidity analysis, reviewing detailed updates prepared by the Financial Analyst and developing scenarios and other decision-support analyses.

• Review and challenge business assumptions with department/program leaders and translate operating activity into reliable organizational forecasts.

• Create a presentation-ready monthly Financial Reporting Package (FRP) for the COO, including financial statements, forecasts, cash position, key variances, risks, opportunities, and financial outlook; partner with the COO and CEO on strategic context, insights, and decision support.


CASH, CONTROLS & GRANT FINANCIAL OVERSIGHT

• Oversee banking and treasury controls while delegating routine banking, cash monitoring, transfer initiation, bank and cash reconciliation preparation, and corporate-card administration to the Financial Analyst within established authorization and segregation-of-duties requirements; review and approve bank and cash reconciliations prepared by the Financial Analyst.

• Establish and continuously improve accounting policies, internal controls, authorization protocols, documentation standards, and finance compliance processes.

• Provide financial leadership for the Chamber’s grant portfolio and supervise the Director of Grant Compliance; ensure grant accounting, coding, allocations, drawdowns, budget-to-actual tracking, financial reporting, and audit readiness are accurate and well controlled.

• Maintain regular coordination with the Director of Grant Compliance on grant budgets, actual results, forecasts, billing/drawdown status, variances, accounting issues, and financial reporting.


AUDIT, SYSTEMS & TEAM LEADERSHIP

• Own the financial statement audit, Form 990, year-end financial package, and Finance team preparation for any required Federal Single Audit; delegate appropriate schedules and workpapers and review the completed work.

• Serve as senior finance process owner for ERP and related finance technology, including integrations with GrowthZone, Ramp, banking, payroll, reporting tools, and successor platforms.

• Lead, coach, and develop the Finance and Accounting Team, including the Financial Analyst and Director of Grant Compliance; establish clear accountability while progressively delegating appropriate accounting, banking, systems, audit-preparation, and analytical work.


FINANCE TRANSFORMATION & STRATEGIC EXECUTION

• Partner with the COO to help develop and execute the Chamber’s finance strategy, translating organizational priorities into scalable accounting, forecasting, cash-management, reporting, systems, and team capabilities.

• Lead the transition of accounting activities from the Chamber’s outsourced accounting provider to a fully internal operating model, establishing clear ownership, controls, procedures, documentation, close responsibilities, and accountability across the Finance team.

• Serve as the senior Finance lead for implementation and optimization of Sage Intacct, Ramp, and related finance systems, including financial-process design, chart-of-accounts and dimensional structure, workflows, controls, integrations, testing, data validation, documentation, and user adoption.

• Partner with the COO to identify, implement, and responsibly adopt AI-enabled finance capabilities, including secure integration with Sage Intacct and other finance platforms, to improve financial reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, analysis, close processes, and management decision support.

• Establish a disciplined monthly close and reconciliation process that appropriately delegates transaction processing, journal entries, reconciliations, schedules, and other preparer responsibilities across the Finance team while maintaining appropriate Controller review and accountability.

• Build and institutionalize enhanced financial-management capabilities, including monthly forecasting and reforecasting, rolling cash-flow forecasting, management analytics, and a presentation-ready monthly financial package for executive leadership and the Board.

• Develop the Finance team into a scalable operating function by establishing clear roles, accountability, cross-training, documented processes, and progressive delegation of responsibilities.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or closely related field and active CPA license required.

• Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible accounting experience with demonstrated ownership of close, financial reporting, audit support, internal controls, and accounting-process leadership; prior Controller title preferred but not required. Demonstrated success developing staff and delegating transactional and close activities within a finance team is required.

• Strong GAAP and technical accounting knowledge required. Nonprofit or grant-funded accounting experience, including ASC 958, is strongly preferred, with federal grant/2 CFR experience highly desired.

• Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting/reforecasting, cash-flow forecasting, variance analysis, management decision support, and cash/treasury oversight.

• Experience coordinating with external auditors and preparing audit-ready workpapers required; nonprofit audits, Federal Single Audits, and Form 990 experience highly desired.

• Strong ERP and Excel capabilities required; experience implementing, materially improving, or serving as a finance lead for an ERP, AP/expense platform, or comparable finance technology is strongly preferred. Experience with Sage Intacct, Business Central, GrowthZone, Ramp, Power BI, automation, or comparable platforms is a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to operate beyond historical accounting and reporting with a strategic, forward-looking orientation toward forecasting, cash management, analysis, and decision support; ability to develop finance staff and communicate financial results, risks, forecasts, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership, Executive Committee, and Board audiences.


CORE COMPETENCIES

Strategic mindset • Team Development and Leadership • Technical accounting judgment • Financial and analytical leadership • Internal controls • Cash and treasury oversight • Executive and Board communication • Systems/process improvement • Change leadership • Integrity and sound judgment

description_text:
BRIEF DESCRIPTION:
At BluSky, we thrive on a systematic financial approach to drive our business
forward. Our Accounts Receivable team supports the company in optimizing our
financial transactions and systems by managing cash influx and ensuring accurate
posting and timely receipts. This meticulous function of Accounts Receivable in
cash application, often operating behind the scenes, profoundly influences
financial equilibrium, supporting our financial trajectory, and securing
revenue.
 
An Accounts Receivable Specialist should demonstrate and adhere to the company
core values including safety, honesty, ownership, and respect to ensure a
successful partnership with customers and employees that results in the
company's continued success.
 
Hourly Pay Range: $25.00 - $28.00
 
PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Cash Application
 * Responsible for the day-to-day cash reconciliation for financial reporting.
   Performs daily cash receipts posting of checks, lockboxes, ACH, Wire
   transfers, and Online and Credit Card Payments.
 * Accurately codes cash receipts to the customer accounts.
 * Runs check deposits through the bank's remote deposit scan.
 * Processes debited deposits (NSFs) and communicates to the PD, BA, and PC for
   collection.
 * Administers phone-in credit card payments through Converge and follows PCI
   compliances.
 * Records Network Fees, Program Fees, Credit Card Fees, and legal Fees to the
   classified GL account.
 * Deposits miscellaneous checks (non-AR related payments) to classified GL
   account.
 * Files check copies to the department shared drive.
 * Monitors incoming office checks, including ACH/Wires, and confirm receipt.

Other Related Tasks
 * Daily monitors department email boxes and responds to inquiries and requests.
 * Collaborate effectively with Finance, Accounting, Sales, and Billing Teams to
   resolve accounting discrepancies and collection activities.
 * Performs administrative and clerical tasks such as data entry, filing
   paperwork, generating reports and statements, and opening and distributing
   mail for the AR department.
 * Performs other duties and projects assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:
 * This role has no direct reports.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:
 * 3+ years' experience in accounts receivable/cash application or relevant
   similar experience.
 * Well-versed in Microsoft Office products, specifically Outlook, Word, and
   Excel.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, effectively converse with
   all company levels.
 * Customer Service Oriented.
 * Strong analytical and organizational skills.
 * High attention to detail and accuracy.
 * Work independently and with a team to complete work.

EDUCATION:
 * Associate or bachelor's degree in business or accounting preferred.

TRAVEL:
 * Occasional travel. (Less than 10% of the time.) Some out-of-area and
   overnight travel may be expected for training or meetings.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL JOB DEMANDS:
The work environment characteristics and physical demands described here are
representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential
functions of this job. These must be met by an employee to successfully perform
the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to
enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 
The noise level in the work environment can range from quiet to significantly
loud. The employee must regularly lift and/or move between 25-50 pounds. While
performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand,
walk, use hands and fingers to handle material, reach with hands and arms, and
talk and hear. The employee is required to regularly move and walk around the
office.
 
COMPENSATION:
This position offers a competitive hourly pay rate and a comprehensive benefits
package that includes: a matching 401(k) plan, health insurance (medical,
dental, and vision), paid time off, paid sick time, paid holidays, disability
coverage, job-specific equipment (e.g., laptop, smartphone, etc.), and a
corporate apparel allowance.
 
BluSky also offers extended benefits such as an Employee Assistance Program,
Accident and Critical Illness Coverage, LegalShield, Professional Development
Opportunities, a Paid Employee Referral Program, Vendor Discounts, and much
more.

EEOC:
BluSky is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity. BluSky
prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees based on age
40 or over, race, sex, color, religion, national origin, disability, genetic
information, sexual orientation, or any other applicable status protected by
Federal, State, or local law.
 
It is and will continue to be the policy of BluSky that all people are entitled
to equal employment opportunity based on their individual qualifications,
performance, and potential without regard for any protected status, as required
by state and federal law.
 
Application Duration:
To ensure a thorough and fair selection process, we would like to inform you
that the application deadline for this position is 10/15/2026. Please ensure
that your application is submitted by this date for consideration.

To be considered for this position, you must complete the online application by
visiting our careers page at www.goblusky.com/careers.

description_text:
SUMMARY



Title: Investment Banking Associate

Group: Specialty Distribution & Business Services

Location: Atlanta

 

WHY STEPHENS



Founded in 1933, Stephens is a privately held, family-owned financial services
firm built on long-term relationships, independent thinking and a commitment to
earning our clients’ trust. For generations, Stephens has helped clients
navigate changing markets, pursue opportunities and develop thoughtful financial
solutions that create lasting value.

 

With offices in strategic locations across the U.S. and Europe, we provide
objective advice and precise execution across the full array of investment
banking services, including M&A, public and private debt and equity capital
raising, restructurings, recapitalizations and other strategic transactions. We
bring sector-informed insight to public, private and family-owned businesses, as
well as financial sponsors, family offices and other institutional investors.

 

At Stephens, bankers build their careers in a collaborative environment that
values sound judgment, initiative, integrity and a commitment to client
outcomes. For candidates who want to be challenged, contribute to meaningful
client work and grow within a stable, relationship-driven platform, Stephens
offers a place to build a meaningful investment banking career over the long
term.

 

SPECIALTY DISTRIBUTION & BUSINESS SERVICES

 

Our Specialty Distribution & Business Services groups have a long-tenured team
of experts who bring sector and execution expertise to middle market
founder-owned and institutionally backed businesses. Our senior bankers have
strong relationships across a variety of distribution and services sectors, with
sub-sector areas of focus including engineered products, industrial supplies and
equipment, automotive aftermarket, commercial and residential services,
professional services and other tech-enabled services. We have extensive
experience conducting successful M&A transactions on both the buy-side and
sell-side, as well as equity and debt capital raises.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



As an Associate at Stephens, you will play a central role on deal teams, helping
drive live engagements, mentor analysts and develop the judgment and leadership
expected of senior investment banking professionals. Associates are entrusted
with important workstreams across financial analysis, due diligence and the
creation and presentation of client materials. These tasks include:

 

 * Driving transaction execution in collaboration with other deal team members
 * Developing and reviewing financial models, valuation analyses, comparable
   company analysis and other transaction-related analyses
 * Creating and presenting client-facing materials, including Confidential
   Information Presentations, management presentations, and marketing pitches
 * Helping plan and execute live engagements, including due diligence, process
   management and coordination with clients and other counterparties
 * Conducting company, industry, buyer/investor and market research
 * Training, mentoring and developing analysts
 * Building relationships and maintaining direct contact with current and
   prospective clients

 

QUALIFICATIONS



 * 2+ years of Investment Banking experience or an MBA plus 1 year of Investment
   Banking Associate experience.
 * Experience advising companies in the Industrials & Services industries a plus
 * Bachelor’s degree
 * Strong analytical, financial modeling and valuation skills, including the
   ability to review and guide analyst work product
 * Demonstrated ability to manage workstreams and prioritize assignments in a
   fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
 * Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
 * High level of personal integrity, accountability and attention to detail
 * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a
   team-oriented environment
 * Commitment to respecting and safeguarding confidential information and
   adherence to regulatory requirements

 

For benefits information, please visit:
