title: Payroll Manager
ai_core_responsibilities: The Payroll Manager oversees end-to-end payroll operations, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely processing across multiple jurisdictions. This role also provides leadership to the payroll team while managing system integrations, reconciliations, and union/certified payroll requirements.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have at least 7 years of progressive payroll experience, including supervisory or management roles. Strong knowledge of multi-state payroll, union regulations, and payroll systems is required.
description_text:
Position Summary

The Payroll Manager is responsible for the overall management and administration
of payroll operations. The position provides leadership and direction to the
payroll team and ensures payroll is processed accurately, timely, efficiently,
and in compliance with applicable requirements.

The Payroll Manager oversees payroll operations across multiple legal entities
and jurisdictions and serves as a key subject matter expert for payroll
processes, systems, reconciliations, controls, and operational compliance.

The position identifies operational risks, resolves complex payroll issues,
strengthens internal controls, and drives continuous improvement and automation
within Payroll.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

 * Champions The Layton Way by delivering predictable outcomes for internal
   teams, external teams, and customers.
 * Ensures that Constructing with Integrity is delivered by working with
   honesty, unity, safety, and quality of work.

Payroll Operations

 * Manage and oversee end-to-end payroll processing for assigned legal entities
   and employee populations.
 * Ensure payrolls are processed accurately and within established calendars and
   deadlines.
 * Establish payroll procedures, controls, checklists, and approval processes.
 * Review payroll results and exception reporting.
 * Serve as the primary escalation point for complex payroll issues.
 * Maintain appropriate segregation of duties and payroll controls.

Union & Certified Payroll

 * Oversee union payroll processing to ensure wages, deductions, benefits, and
   employer contributions are calculated and reported in accordance with
   applicable collective bargaining agreements.
 * Ensure union wage rates, classifications, fringes, dues, and other payroll
   requirements are accurately maintained and applied.
 * Oversee certified payroll and prevailing wage compliance, including accurate
   employee classifications, wage and fringe requirements, and timely reporting.
 * Ensure certified payroll reports and supporting documentation are accurate,
   complete, and retained in accordance with contract and regulatory
   requirements.
 * Partner with project teams, HR, Legal, and union representatives to research
   and resolve union, prevailing wage, and certified payroll issues.
 * Support audits, inquiries, and compliance reviews related to union and
   certified payroll.

Team Leadership

 * Lead Payroll Clerks, Payroll Specialists, Senior Payroll Specialists, Payroll
   Administrators, and Senior Payroll Administrators.
 * Assign responsibilities and establish process ownership.
 * Monitor workload, deadlines, performance, and coverage.
 * Coach and develop payroll employees.
 * Establish cross-training and succession plans.
 * Develop future payroll leaders.

Payroll Tax & Regulatory Partnership

 * Ensure payroll transactions and tax-driving employee data are accurate.
 * Maintain sufficient federal, state, and local payroll tax knowledge to
   identify potential risks.
 * Partner with the Payroll Tax Manager on taxation issues requiring specialized
   review.
 * Coordinate payroll corrections necessary to support accurate tax reporting.
 * Ensure employee residence, work location, earnings, and deductions are
   appropriately maintained for payroll processing.

Payroll Systems & Integrations

 * Serve as business owner and subject matter expert for payroll systems.
 * Partner with HRIS, IT, Finance, and vendors on payroll integrations.
 * Oversee payroll testing and validation.
 * Identify and resolve system and integration issues.
 * Lead system improvements and automation initiatives.

Payroll Accounting & Reconciliation

 * Oversee payroll reconciliations.
 * Partner with Accounting and Finance on payroll expenses, liabilities,
   benefits, taxes, and general ledger activity.
 * Establish appropriate reconciliation controls.
 * Support quarterly and year-end payroll reconciliation.
 * Support internal and external audits.

Decision-Making & Authority

 * Direct daily payroll activities.
 * Establish payroll procedures and controls within approved policies.
 * Approve or recommend payroll corrections.
 * Recommend system and process changes.
 * Escalate payroll, financial, compliance, or system risks.
 * Stop or escalate payroll processing when a material error or compliance risk
   exists.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Required

 * Strong knowledge of payroll administration and payroll processes.
 * Strong understanding of federal, state, and local payroll tax requirements.
 * Experience managing multi-state payroll operations.
 * Working knowledge of union payroll, collective bargaining agreements,
   prevailing wage requirements, and certified payroll reporting.
 * Strong knowledge of payroll reconciliations, controls, and audit
   requirements.
 * Demonstrated ability to research and resolve complex payroll issues.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Ability to identify root causes and develop sustainable solutions.
 * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 * Ability to maintain confidential employee and payroll information.
 * Ability to lead, coach, and develop payroll professionals.
 * Strong understanding of payroll systems and data integrations.
 * Minimum of 7 years of progressive payroll experience.
 * Previous supervisory or management experience

Preferred

 * Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Human Resources, or a related
   field.
 * CPP certification.
 * Experience with enterprise payroll systems.
 * Experience with CMiC or similar construction payroll systems.
 * Experience with payroll tax engines such as Vertex.
 * Experience with HRIS/payroll integrations.
 * Experience with payroll system implementations, conversions, or major
   upgrades.
 * Experience supporting payroll tax audits and multi-state compliance.
 * Construction industry payroll experience.

 * Experience with union payroll, prevailing wage, and certified payroll
   reporting in the construction industry.
   
    

Benefits: Layton Construction offers the following benefits for this position,
subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical Insurance, Dental
Insurance, Vision Insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible
Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, 401(k) retirement
plan with employer match, Life & AD&D Insurance, Long-term Disability Insurance,
Short-term Disability Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance,
Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Home & Auto Insurance, Family Support, Pre-tax
Paid Parking/Public Transportation, Paid time off, Time Away Benefits, Paid
Holidays, Group Legal, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Identity Theft Protection,
Group Legal, Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program.

description_text:
Job Summary:

The Valuation & Capital Market Analysis Associate – Complex Financial
Instruments is responsible for utilizing previously obtained educational
background, along with established organizational and project management skills
to successfully service clients of the Valuation & Capital Market Analysis
 group.  In this role, the Associate will work within a team environment to
actively assist in the analysis and resolution of client matters while taking
direction and receiving guidance from experienced staff and management members.
 The Associate will be involved in all stages of client management including
construction of valuation modeling, completion of industry and client research
and analysis of financial statements.

 
Job Duties:

 * Assists with the delivery of projects related to the valuation of illiquid
   and complex securities, hard-to-value assets, financial derivatives
   (including over-the-counter derivatives), and structured products.
 * Constructs financial models used in the valuation of complex financial
   instruments for financial reporting, tax and regulatory compliance,
   transaction support, and corporate strategy
 * Uses mathematical and statistical financial models for valuations of multiple
   asset classes including complex securities, options, derivatives, and credit
   instruments, including but not limited to, Monte Carlo simulations and
   Lattice Models 
 * May aid in the delivery of services related to hedge advisory, strategic
   assessment, model validation, economic studies, and other advisory projects
 * Prepares necessary exhibits and memos in illustration of complex issues 
 * Composes narrative reports in support of valuation analyses 
 * Documents and maintains all appropriate aspects of work product
 * Ensures quality controls are adhered in association with all work products 
 * Participates in internal and external client meetings 
 * Performs related company, industry, and economic research 
 * Assists and provides guidance to peers and staff members in the development
   of project plans and timelines for deliverables 
 * Other duties as required 


Supervisory Responsibilities:

 * N/A


Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Education:

 * Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Actuarial Science, Risk
   Management, Mathematics, or Economics, required 
 * Graduate degree or relevant credential (e.g., FRM, CFA), preferred

Experience:

 * Prior experience (internship or work study) in valuation, corporate finance
   or accounting environment, preferred 

Software:

 * Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel,
   PowerPoint and Word, required
 * Familiarity with VBA, Python, R, or other programming language, preferred
 * Prior experience with Capital IQ, FactSet, SNL, or Bloomberg, preferred 

Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 * Superior analytical skills with the ability to deconstruct complex issues 
 * Intermediate or higher knowledge of spreadsheets and computer adaptability
 * Ability to analyze and organize high volumes of data
 * Solid organizational skills especially ability to meet project deadlines with
   a focus on details
 * Ability to successfully multi-task while working independently or within a
   group environment
 * Proven ability to work in a deadline-driven environment and handle multiple
   projects simultaneously 
 * Ability to successfully interact with professionals at all levels

description_text:
Earthwise, a Bunzl company, is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and
organized Senior Accounting Clerk to join our Accounting team. As a Senior
Accounting Clerk, you will perform a variety of accounting and administrative
functions to support the accuracy and efficiency of financial operations. You
will be responsible for maintaining financial records, processing transactions,
performing account reconciliations, supporting month-end close activities, and
assisting with accounts receivable and accounts payable functions.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of handling
multiple priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and
professionalism.

As part of Bunzl's Earthwise segment, you'll support the sales of reusable
shopping bags and custom-branded bag programs designed to help retailers reduce
single-use waste and meet sustainability goals. Our product portfolio includes
reusable grocery bags, insulated bags, tote bags, wine and beverage bags, and
seasonal promotional bags. Customers include grocery chains, retailers,
convenience stores, and other commercial businesses seeking innovative,
environmentally responsible solutions

This is a remote (work from home) role that can sit anywhere in United States.
There may be some travel to our Glendale, CA office required a few times a
year. 

Responsibilities:

 * Manage customer account setup and maintenance, including credit limits,
   reporting requirements, and account master data in the AS400.
 * Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries regarding
   billing, payments, account status, and collections.
 * Process customer payments, credits, adjustments, and account reconciliations
   while ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
 * Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies, deductions, chargebacks, and
   other account-related issues.
 * Monitor accounts receivable aging reports, proactively follow up on
   delinquent accounts, and escalate credit risks to management.
 * Maintain accurate documentation of collection activities, customer
   communications, and account records.
 * Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, including
   account reconciliations, report balancing, and general ledger review.
 * Support internal and external audit activities by preparing and providing
   required documentation and financial records.
 * Provide cross-functional support and backup coverage for Accounts Payable and
   other accounting functions as needed.
 * Identify opportunities for process improvement and participate in special
   projects that enhance departmental efficiency and effectiveness.
 * Achieve individual performance objectives, complete required training, and
   contribute to departmental and company goals.
 * Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting procedures, and internal
   controls while delivering a high level of customer service.

Requirements:

 * High School diploma or equivalent is required.
 * Associate/Bachelor's degree preferred.
 * 5+ years of experience in accounting, including knowledge of basic accounting
   principles and the A/R & A/P processes.
 * Must be detailed oriented and organized.
 * Ability to multi-task, establish priorities, and work well in a team-oriented
   environment.
 * Self-motivated with ability to work independently or as a team.
 * Effectively use Microsoft Office products such as Excel, Word, Outlook, &

 * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with a customer service

 * Experience with AS400 a plus, but not required.

title: Property Accountant
ai_core_responsibilities: The Property Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, including accounts receivable, rent processing, and security deposit dispositions. They also manage delinquent rent documentation and coordinate with attorneys for collection actions.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have at least 2 years of experience in property management and intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. A high school diploma is required, while a degree in accounting or a related field is preferred.
description_text:
Salary: $20 - $22 hourly
WPM Real Estate Management is seeking a detail-oriented Property Accountant to support the financial operations of our managed properties. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate records of accounts receivable, processing and reconciling resident and tenant charges and payments, and ensuring the integrity of property-level financial data. 



What You'll Do
· Ensures that all rent-related monies received by the company are properly identified, recorded, deposited into the correct property’s bank account and recorded properly in the accounting system.
· Ensures accuracy of leasing information entered into the accounting system.
· Receives and reviews paperwork from properties pertaining to resident moves out, preparing security disposition letters and requesting refunded security deposits from accounts payable.
· Documents property residents who are delinquent in their rent payments after the 5th day of each month, prepares and signs Failure to Pay Rent Court Notices, check requests and checks.
· Prepares and sends paperwork to attorney for collection actions, attending court with the attorney, as required. Tracks late and court fees in the accounting system.
· Notifies Property Managers of trial dates and case numbers, providing the Property Managers with documentation necessary for them to represent the company in Rent Court matters.
· Prepares and sends rent and utility bills.
· Processes month end reports and files.
· Responds to inquiries from residents, managers, leasing agents, etc., preparing formal correspondence, as necessary.
· Maintains resident and property files.

What We're Looking For
· Skilled at an intermediate level of proficiency with Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Outlook
· Basic knowledge of accounting principles
· Familiarity with Jenark or other property management accounting systems
· Ability work effectively in teams
· Ability to operate standard office equipment, including, but not limited to standard calculators, copy machines, fax machines, telephones and computers
· Ability to manage priorities and multi-task
· Must possess strong mathematical, financial, and analytical abilities
· Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing
· Ability to use tact in communicating difficult messages

title: Senior Director of FP&A
ai_core_responsibilities: The Senior Director of FP&A will lead strategic finance partnerships for the B2B SaaS business, overseeing revenue forecasting, financial planning, and performance management. They will also manage and develop a globally distributed team while providing independent financial perspectives to support executive decision-making and strategic initiatives.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must have 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A or strategic finance with a strong background in B2B SaaS economics and revenue organizations. Additionally, the role requires at least 3 years of people leadership experience and proficiency in enterprise planning systems like Adaptive, Anaplan, or NetSuite.
description_text:
About the Company:
At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real-world connections.
The Role You'll Play
Playlist is looking for a Senior Director of Financial Planning & Analysis to lead strategic finance partnership across our B2B SaaS business, supporting the Studio Fitness and Beauty verticals. In this highly visible role, you’ll bring a commercial and financial perspective to decisions about revenue growth, go-to-market strategy, investment, forecasting, and business performance.
As a trusted partner to General Managers and senior leaders, you’ll connect financial performance to business drivers, challenge assumptions, and help the organization navigate complex tradeoffs. You’ll also lead and develop a globally distributed FP&A team of approximately six team members across the U.S. and Brazil.
Serve as the senior finance partner for Playlist’s B2B SaaS business to translate business strategy into financial plans, forecasts, and targets, across Studio Fitness and Beauty (Mindbody, Booker, and new products)
Collaborate with General Managers, senior go-to-market leaders, and product/engineering leaders to ensure alignment of financial performance, stakeholder priorities, and operational discipline to achieve long-term goals for the business 
Own revenue forecasting and performance management, including annual planning and monthly business reviews, to ensure leaders understand clear connection between financial results and commercial performance
Guide decisions about growth, investment, prioritization, and resource allocation by challenging assumptions and offering an independent financial perspective
Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and business cases that support strategic initiatives, annual planning, and executive decisions
Lead, coach, and develop a distributed FP&A team across the U.S. and Brazil, strengthening its commercial capabilities and partnership with the business
Advance the FP&A function by improving forecasting, processes, insights, and decision support as Playlist evolves
Support strategic initiatives, including potential M&A and financial due diligence, and take on additional ownership across the B2B portfolio as needed
The Experience You’ll Bring
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, or a related area, including significant support for revenue and go-to-market organizations
3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing effective finance teams
Deep fluency in B2B SaaS economics: subscription business models, payments processing, unit economics including ARR/MRR/GRR/NRR, cohort retention, CAC and payback
Expertise in financial modeling,forecasting, planning, and data analysis, with the ability to distill complex data and financial topics into clear strategic insight and compelling narratives for executives, the Board, and investors
Experience with enterprise planning and reporting systems (e.g., Adaptive, Anaplan, NetSuite) and a point of view on applying AI and automation to finance workflows
A track record of growing your responsibility, scope, and impact over time
Nice to Have
Deep experience supporting go-to-market teams within a B2B SaaS or recurring-revenue business
Experience working across multiple products, business units, or customer segments
Consulting, strategic finance, high-growth startup experience, or PE-backed technology company
Experience navigating significant organizational or revenue growth
Exposure to M&A, financial due diligence, or strategic transactions
Experience leading teams across geographies or time zones
What Success Looks Like 
Success in this role goes beyond delivering an accurate forecast. You’ll become a trusted strategic finance partner to Playlist’s B2B leadership team, bringing a deep understanding of the business and an independent, commercially minded perspective to critical decisions.
You’ll strengthen the connection between strategy, revenue performance, go-to-market execution, and financial outcomes. You’ll also build a proactive finance team that is closely connected to the business and equipped to help Playlist understand where it’s going financially and what it will take to get there.

description_text:
Position Summary

 

This position works under general supervision to perform intermediate-level
professional accounting work in the areas of property tax, conducting tax parcel
calculations, some general ledger accounting, and other related accounting
functions.

 

Pay Grade: 52 

Salary Commensurate with Experience and Education
 

 

Minimum Qualifications

 

 * Three (3) years of proven experience in the use of accounting principles,
   techniques, and theories; AND
 * Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in accounting,
   finance, or a related field; OR
 * An equivalent combination of related education and/or experience.
 * Experience in a public agency preferred.
 * PROOF OF EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND/OR EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED.

 

Duties and Responsibilities

 

 * Maintains accounting records involving technical accounting data.
 * Updates and analyzes database activity for tax parcels. Prepares specialized
   accounting reports.
 * Records and reconciles to general ledger accounts; prepares journal entries;
   makes corrections or adjustments as needed
 * Integrates accounts receivable according to tax parcels; processes and posts
   payments received for taxes or fees; reviews receipts, escrow accounts, and
   other financial reports.
 * Research and resolve issues regarding technical accounting problems.
 * Performs other duties as required or directed.

 

KSAs

 

 * Knowledge of accounting theories and practices.
 * Skilled in the utilization of Microsoft Office software.
 * Ability to prioritize and complete multiple assignments concurrently.
 * Ability to maintain detailed accounting records.
 * Ability to manipulate data within database programs.
 * Ability to use systems, knowledge, and skills to produce consistently
   error-free results.
 * Ability to deal tactfully with the public and co-workers.
 * Ability to exercise good judgment in evaluating situations and making
   decisions.
 * Ability to express ideas clearly and concisely, orally and in writing.
 * Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics, Great Plains, preferred.

 

Disclaimer 

This position is subject to a background check for any convictions that have a
substantial relationship to potential job duties. Only convictions that are
substantially related to potential job duties will be considered and will not
automatically disqualify the candidate.

 

Shelby County Resident Disclaimer

All employees hired after September 1, 1986, must be residents of Shelby County
and shall continue to reside in the County as a condition of their employment. 
The residency requirement shall not apply to certain public safety/civil service
employees.  This means exemption from this policy is in effect for the following
departments and positions: (1) Sheriff Deputy Patrol Officers, Deputy Jailers
and Dispatchers, employed by the Sheriff Department, (2) Correction Officers
employed by the Division of Corrections, (3) Firefighters, Paramedics and
Dispatchers employed by the Shelby County Fire Department.  The residency
exemption for public safety/civil service employees does not include Appointed
positions with Sheriff’s Office, Division of Corrections or the Fire Department.

title: Tax Manager
ai_core_responsibilities: The Tax Manager will oversee a portfolio of business and individual clients, managing tax compliance, planning, and engagement budgets. They will also lead, mentor, and coach staff members while ensuring all work meets the firm's quality standards.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting and possess an active CPA license or Enrolled Agent credential. A minimum of 5 years of progressive public accounting tax experience with review responsibility is required.
description_text:
About Ascend
Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a dynamic platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while accessing the resources of a Top 25 firm to help them grow. Ascend provides access to growth capital, robust talent acquisition and training, leading quality management resources, best-of-breed technology, AI tools, an offshore captive, shared back-office services, a catalytic leadership system, and modernized equity incentives so that firms can surmount today’s industry challenges to reach their full potential. For more information, visit www.ascendtogether.com.
About Tronconi Segarra & Associates
We are a top 3 accounting and advisory firm in Western New York with nearly 140 partners and associates, including 70 CPAs serving clients across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and South & Central America. We serve all industries and have deep expertise in small business, manufacturing, education, e-commerce, aerospace & defense, construction, insurance, professional services, private equity, non-profits, and government entities. Our key services include Tax Advisory services, M&A/Transaction Advisory services, State & Local Tax services, Client Accounting & Advisory Services (CAAS), Audit & Attestation Advisory services. We have many additional services that we specialize in. We strategically partnered with Ascend, an accounting firm platform, in 2025 to expand our footprint and enhance our capabilities and service offerings to our clients.
The Opportunity
As a Tax Manager at Tronconi Segarra & Associates (TSA), you will own a portfolio of business and individual clients and serve as their trusted advisor from start to finish. You will oversee tax compliance and planning across a broad mix of entity types and industries, review and sign returns, and lead the teams that deliver the work. This role is ideal for a well-rounded tax professional who wants real ownership of client relationships, enjoys developing others, and is looking for the autonomy to build and manage their own book.
TSA’s Tax practice is built on a generalist model, giving managers exposure to a wide range of clients rather than a single niche, with room to deepen expertise as you advance. Supported by TSA’s strategic partnership with Ascend, the practice is positioned for continued growth. You will work alongside Tax leadership to serve clients, mentor staff and seniors, and help shape a culture of accountability, coaching, and high-quality client service. This is a hybrid role based in our Williamsville, NY office.
How You’ll Help Us Build a Confident Future
Serve as the primary relationship lead for a portfolio of closely held businesses and individuals, delivering responsive, high-quality service.
Oversee tax compliance and planning for individuals, partnerships, S corporations, and C corporations.
Review and sign returns, ensuring work meets TSA’s quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Anticipate client needs and identify planning, advisory, and cross-selling opportunities.
Manage engagement budgets, timelines, and scope, communicating proactively with clients.
Plan, assign, and review the work of staff and seniors, providing timely and constructive feedback.
Coach and mentor team members, contributing to training and the Firm’s recruiting efforts.
Stay current on tax law changes and translate complex matters into clear guidance for clients.
Use the Firm’s technology, including AI-enabled tools where appropriate, to improve quality and efficiency.
What You Need to Succeed
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or a related field.
Active CPA license or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.
Progressive public accounting tax experience 5+ years, including review responsibility.
Broad experience with business entity and individual tax compliance.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and lead a team.
What Will Give You an Edge
Experience with CCH Axcess and CCH Engagement.
Experience serving closely held businesses across a variety of industries.
A track record of managing your own book of clients.
Passion for mentoring and developing staff.
What We Offer
Ownership of your client relationships and the autonomy to manage your own book.
Clear growth path, with opportunities to deepen expertise by entity type as you advance.
One-on-one career development mentoring and the opportunity to attend professional development courses, including the Tronconi Segarra & Associates Leadership Academy.
Exposure to a wide variety of challenging assignments and the ability to work on special projects and develop practice area expertise.
In-office, flexible, and alternative working arrangements.
Competitive salary and benefits, paid vacation and sick time, and nine paid holidays.
The annual base salary range for this role is $80,000 – $120,000. This range includes the anticipated low and high end of TSA’s salary range for this position. Actual compensation may vary based on various factors, including experience, education and/or skill level.
At Ascend, we provide a fair and equal employment opportunity for all candidates regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, marital status, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. description_text:
About Ascend
Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a dynamic platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while accessing the resources of a Top 25 firm to help them grow. Ascend provides access to growth capital, robust talent acquisition and training, leading quality management resources, best-of-breed technology, AI tools, an offshore captive, shared back-office services, a catalytic leadership system, and modernized equity incentives so that firms can surmount today’s industry challenges to reach their full potential. For more information, visit www.ascendtogether.com.
About Tronconi Segarra & Associates
We are a top 3 accounting and advisory firm in Western New York with nearly 140 partners and associates, including 70 CPAs serving clients across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and South & Central America. We serve all industries and have deep expertise in small business, manufacturing, education, e-commerce, aerospace & defense, construction, insurance, professional services, private equity, non-profits, and government entities. Our key services include Tax Advisory services, M&A/Transaction Advisory services, State & Local Tax services, Client Accounting & Advisory Services (CAAS), Audit & Attestation Advisory services. We have many additional services that we specialize in. We strategically partnered with Ascend, an accounting firm platform, in 2025 to expand our footprint and enhance our capabilities and service offerings to our clients.
The Opportunity
As a Tax Manager at Tronconi Segarra & Associates (TSA), you will own a portfolio of business and individual clients and serve as their trusted advisor from start to finish. You will oversee tax compliance and planning across a broad mix of entity types and industries, review and sign returns, and lead the teams that deliver the work. This role is ideal for a well-rounded tax professional who wants real ownership of client relationships, enjoys developing others, and is looking for the autonomy to build and manage their own book.
TSA’s Tax practice is built on a generalist model, giving managers exposure to a wide range of clients rather than a single niche, with room to deepen expertise as you advance. Supported by TSA’s strategic partnership with Ascend, the practice is positioned for continued growth. You will work alongside Tax leadership to serve clients, mentor staff and seniors, and help shape a culture of accountability, coaching, and high-quality client service. This is a hybrid role based in our Williamsville, NY office.
How You’ll Help Us Build a Confident Future
Serve as the primary relationship lead for a portfolio of closely held businesses and individuals, delivering responsive, high-quality service.
Oversee tax compliance and planning for individuals, partnerships, S corporations, and C corporations.
Review and sign returns, ensuring work meets TSA’s quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Anticipate client needs and identify planning, advisory, and cross-selling opportunities.
Manage engagement budgets, timelines, and scope, communicating proactively with clients.
Plan, assign, and review the work of staff and seniors, providing timely and constructive feedback.
Coach and mentor team members, contributing to training and the Firm’s recruiting efforts.
Stay current on tax law changes and translate complex matters into clear guidance for clients.
Use the Firm’s technology, including AI-enabled tools where appropriate, to improve quality and efficiency.
What You Need to Succeed
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or a related field.
Active CPA license or Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.
Progressive public accounting tax experience 5+ years, including review responsibility.
Broad experience with business entity and individual tax compliance.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and lead a team.
What Will Give You an Edge
Experience with CCH Axcess and CCH Engagement.
Experience serving closely held businesses across a variety of industries.
A track record of managing your own book of clients.
Passion for mentoring and developing staff.
What We Offer
Ownership of your client relationships and the autonomy to manage your own book.
Clear growth path, with opportunities to deepen expertise by entity type as you advance.
One-on-one career development mentoring and the opportunity to attend professional development courses, including the Tronconi Segarra & Associates Leadership Academy.
Exposure to a wide variety of challenging assignments and the ability to work on special projects and develop practice area expertise.
In-office, flexible, and alternative working arrangements.
Competitive salary and benefits, paid vacation and sick time, and nine paid holidays.
The annual base salary range for this role is $80,000 – $120,000. This range includes the anticipated low and high end of TSA’s salary range for this position. Actual compensation may vary based on various factors, including experience, education and/or skill level.

Street Legal is currently seeking a Payroll Specialist to join our Corporate Office in Oak Ridge, TN.

At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.
Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.
Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
Join our team as the Sr. Manager, Revenue Accounting Operations (Professional Services & Bookings), where you will lead the day-to-day execution and scaling of our professional services revenue operations, ensure consistent compliance with ASC 606, and drive the continued optimization of our contract to cash processes.
In this role, you will oversee the accounting operations for complex professional services customer contracts, champion system automation and data integrity across our financial tech stack, and serve as a trusted business partner to cross-functional GTM teams.
Central to this role is leading, scaling, and mentoring a high-performing, geographically distributed team. You will be responsible for fostering a collaborative, continuous-improvement culture across global time zones, ensuring operational alignment and professional development.
You will play a critical role in managing the month-end close cycle, strengthening internal controls, supporting audits, and identifying opportunities to improve systems, data flows, and reporting as the company grows. You will also own the operational reporting for corporate bookings, including related commissions-driven adjustments.
This is a highly visible, operationally intensive role that requires strong business judgment, leadership, and the ability to balance hands-on execution with strategic process design.
Your Impact
Operational Revenue Ownership: Own and oversee revenue accounting operations for professional services contracts, including billing, revenue recognition milestones, margin analysis, and reporting, ensuring compliance with ASC 606 and company policy.
Commercial & Operational Contract Review: Partner closely with Sales and Deal Desk as the primary operational reviewer of non-standard and amended customer contracts, ensuring operational feasibility, billing scalability, and seamless CRM-to-ERP system flow prior to deal closure.
Bookings Reporting and Compliance: Oversee corporate bookings metrics and reporting, ensuring accurate application of internal bookings policies.
Cross-Functional GTM Partnership: Partner closely with Go-To-Market teams—including Professional Services, Deal Desk, Order Management, Legal, and FP&A—to support deal structuring, resolve billing and downstream revenue issues, and improve Contract-to-Cash velocity.
System Automation & Process Optimization: Identify, prioritize, and lead initiatives to enhance revenue systems, including CRM to ERM automation and business process enhancements.
Enterprise Tech Stack Mastery: Develop deep operational expertise in our ERP and CRM environments (Workday, Salesforce, and related systems), providing guidance on system usage, troubleshooting integration issues, and supporting scalable data design.
Special Projects Leadership: Lead and contribute to revenue-related special projects, including new product rollouts, CRM/ERP upgrades, policy rollouts, and GTM-led transformation efforts.
Audit Readiness: Manage and support external audit activities related to revenue operations and contract-to-cash, serving as a key point of contact to ensure timely, data-backed, and accurate responses.
Team Mentorship & Growth: Coach and mentor revenue accounting team members, supporting skill development, knowledge sharing, and consistent execution of operational best practices.
Anaplan Integration: Complete Anaplan training and contribute to the enhancement and ongoing development of internally used Anaplan models to drive better automated reporting and forecasting.
Your Qualifications
Experience: 8+ years of progressive revenue accounting and revenue operations experience, with strong expertise in ASC 606; public SaaS company and/or fast-growing enterprise software experience strongly preferred.
Systems Expertise (Strongly Preferred): Hands-on, administrative-level or power-user experience with Workday and Salesforce, including a proven track record of managing CRM-to-ERP integrations.
CPA or equivalent certification is a plus
Operational Analytical Skills: Proven ability to interpret complex contract terms and business requirements and translate them into scalable, automated operational workflows in our systems.
Process Builder Mindset: Demonstrated experience leading process improvement initiatives that reduce manual Excel work, deepen analytical understanding, and streamline operational accounting workflows.
Collaboration & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between GTM teams (Professional Services/Deal Desk) and Accounting to influence operational outcomes without direct authority.
Resilience in Growth: Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving processes and integrated enterprise systems.
People Leadership: 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring a team of direct reports.

problems, and build with purpose. Join us to build the future.
 
Your Impact

collections to ensure the company is paid accurately and on time. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable with
technology, picks up new systems quickly, and takes pride in getting the details right. Your attention to detail and
commitment to process excellence will help support the company’s continued growth and operational success.
 
Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities
 * Billing & Invoicing

 * Collections & Customer Support

 * Reporting & Close Support

   * Maintain organized, audit-ready digital records of invoices, payments, and supporting documentation
 * General Responsibilities
   * Utilize Epicor, Avalara, customer portals, and other systems to maintain accurate financial records and reporting
   * Support internal and external audits by providing requested documentation
   * Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automate accounts receivable processes
   * Collaborate with project management, sales, operations, and finance teams to resolve issues
   * Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Qualifications
 * High school diploma or equivalent required
 * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred
 * 1–3 years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or a related accounting role
 * Strong technology skills and comfort learning new software, including ERP systems, automation tools, and online
 * portals
 * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables
 * Experience with ERP or accounting systems required; Epicor experience preferred
 * Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in a high-volume environment
 * Strong organizational and time management skills
 * Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort reaching out to customers about payments
 * Exposure to construction or project-based billing (AIA, retention, lien waivers) a plus

Benefits
 * Paid time off
 * 401(k) retirement plan with company match
 * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
 * Collaborative, high-energy workplace
 * Career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding organization

Our Core Values
 * Safety - We proactively protect our people and environment
 * Inclusion - We respect and appreciate diverse perspectives and backgrounds
 * Speed - We move fast, act decisively, and stay agile
 * Innovation - We challenge assumptions and simplify processes
 * Judgment - We make sound decisions with the business in mind
 * Accountability - We take ownership and deliver results

Physical Demands and Work Environment
Employees must be able to communicate effectively and operate standard office equipment, including computers, phones,
keyboards, and printers. This role requires extended periods of sitting, reviewing invoices, performing data entry, and working within accounting
systems. Employees may occasionally be required to stand, walk, or lift office materials. The work environment is primarily
an office setting with moderate noise levels and frequent interaction with customers and internal teams. Reasonable
accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

description_text:
Organizational Overview: 
The Cincinnati Center City Development Corporation (3CDC) is a tax-exempt nonprofit focused on revitalizing Cincinnati’s urban core, particularly the Central Business District and Over-The-Rhine. Partnering with the City of Cincinnati and the corporate community, 3CDC works to create a vibrant downtown through development, programming, and district management, supported by a team of roughly 185 full-time and 150 part-time staff.
 
3CDC At-a-Glance
 * 3CDC has contributed to more than $2B in development across Downtown and OTR, including civic spaces, mixed-income housing, and mixed-use projects.
 * The organization manages nearly 700K square feet of commercial space, ~200 apartment units, and 5,900+ parking spaces, generating $51M+ annually.
 * 3CDC oversees seven civic spaces, hosting nearly 1,600 free events each year.
 * 3CDC also manages the Downtown Cincinnati and OTR South Special Improvement Districts, providing clean and safe services, outreach, beautification, and marketing.

Why Join Us?
At 3CDC, you’ll have the opportunity to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your contributions make a tangible impact on the community. This role offers meaningful industry experience, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to be part of a team dedicated to strengthening and energizing Cincinnati’s urban core.
  
Job Summary:
The Staff Accountant will be responsible for the general accounting, internal reporting, treasury management, and compliance functions. This role will be supporting 3CDC’s financing of real estate assets including debt management, loan servicing and tax compliance. The position will be required to communicate frequently with individuals outside of the department and organization.
 
Tasks:
 * Responsible for implementation of the accounting policies and procedures for the assigned functional area, keeping all applicable accounting records in accordance with those as well as Generally Accepted Accounting Principles and tax regulations.
 * Prepares and approves general ledger entries on a regular basis, monitors accounts, and prepares complete and accurate account reconciliations on a monthly and/or quarterly basis.
 * Assists in the preparation of internal reporting provided to management on a monthly basis, focusing on financial performance to established budgets and projections for the organization as well as key operating metrics that have been established for each type of operating asset.
 * Collaborate continually with the operations staff to enhance management and internal reporting.
 * Supports the area’s Accounting Director and Accounting Manager in coordinating annual audits and tax return compliance with external accountants.
 * Responds to inquiries from management and other interested parties regarding accounting data, reporting and project investments.
 * Completes special projects, as assigned.

 
Qualifications:
 * Associate or Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) from an accredited college or university in accounting or related degree program is required.
 * Related internship, co-op or work experience in accounting preferred.
 * Demonstrates ability to gain a strong working knowledge of 3CDC’s mission and ongoing development activities and to effectively articulate such activities in a verbal and written form.
 * Strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills and work habits.
 * Solid time management skills; ability to handle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and function independently and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
 * Experience in problem solving with ability to recognize issues and deal with them directly.
 * Personable, positive, and enthusiastic attitude with capability to deal effectively with people (both internal and external).
 * Excellent oral and written communications skills.
 * Flexible with ability to work in a team setting supporting several people.

 
Skills or specialized knowledge:
 * Must be able to maintain the highest degree of confidentiality.

 
Work Environment 
 * This is an in-office position, Monday through Friday, with consistent onsite presence required to support operational systems, vendor coordination, and cross-department collaboration. 

 * Occasional evening or weekend work may be necessary for system upgrades or urgent issues. 

Disclaimer
This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. The employee will also perform other reasonably related business duties as assigned by their immediate supervisor and other management as required.

Tasks:
 * 45% -Directs the work of a team of up to 3 staff accountants in preparing and posting general ledger entries on a regular basis.  This includes monitoring accounts which will require frequent communication with individuals outside the accounting department.  In addition, all applicable records must be maintained in accordance with accounting policies and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.
 * 10% -Assists the Accounting Managers in the preparation of the consolidated financial statements for 3CDC as well as applicable affiliates.
 * 10%- Supports Senior Accounting Managers and Accounting Managers in coordinating annual audits and tax return compliance with external accountants.
 * 20%- Supports Senior Accounting Manager in the Preparation of internal reporting, maintaining updated forecasts, and once a year assisting in the preparation of annual budgets for every operating asset.
 * 10%- Responds to inquiries from management and other interested parties regarding accounting data, internal reporting, and cash on hand balances, etc.
 * 5%- Completes special projects, as assigned. 

 
Qualifications:
 * Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) from an accredited college or university in accounting or related degree program is required.  Graduate degree in a similar field is desired.
 * Minimum of 3 years of directly related experience in a leadership position within a public or private organization in accounting and finance.  Candidate with both public accounting and private company experience preferred.
 * Experience managing staff. 
 * Demonstrated skills, knowledge and directly related experience in the real estate, leasing, consolidation, internal controls and general accounting concepts. 
 * Strong research skills related to technical issues on transactions in terms of the internal revenue code and/or generally accepted accounting principles.
 * Demonstrated ability to gain a strong working knowledge of 3CDC’s mission and ongoing development activities and to effectively articulate such activities in a verbal and written form.

 * Personable, positive, and enthusiastic attitude with capability to deal effectively with people (both internal and external). 
 * Excellent oral and written communications skills.

 
Licenses, Credentials, Certifications: 
 * Active CPA license, preferred

 
Skills or specialized knowledge: 
 * Extensive experience using Microsoft Office, especially Excel
 * Experience using (or the ability to learn the following software)
   * The Financial Edge
   * The Mortgage Office
   * Blackline
   * Ariel
 * Must be able to maintain the highest degree of confidentiality

 * Frequently required to sit at a desk/workstation for long periods of time.

 * Digital dexterity and hand/eye coordination in operation of office equipment.

 * The ability to work well under stress.

description_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.
Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.
Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
Join our team as the Sr. Manager, Revenue Accounting Operations (Professional Services & Bookings), where you will lead the day-to-day execution and scaling of our professional services revenue operations, ensure consistent compliance with ASC 606, and drive the continued optimization of our contract to cash processes.
In this role, you will oversee the accounting operations for complex professional services customer contracts, champion system automation and data integrity across our financial tech stack, and serve as a trusted business partner to cross-functional GTM teams.
Central to this role is leading, scaling, and mentoring a high-performing, geographically distributed team. You will be responsible for fostering a collaborative, continuous-improvement culture across global time zones, ensuring operational alignment and professional development.
You will play a critical role in managing the month-end close cycle, strengthening internal controls, supporting audits, and identifying opportunities to improve systems, data flows, and reporting as the company grows. You will also own the operational reporting for corporate bookings, including related commissions-driven adjustments.
This is a highly visible, operationally intensive role that requires strong business judgment, leadership, and the ability to balance hands-on execution with strategic process design.
Your Impact
Operational Revenue Ownership: Own and oversee revenue accounting operations for professional services contracts, including billing, revenue recognition milestones, margin analysis, and reporting, ensuring compliance with ASC 606 and company policy.
Commercial & Operational Contract Review: Partner closely with Sales and Deal Desk as the primary operational reviewer of non-standard and amended customer contracts, ensuring operational feasibility, billing scalability, and seamless CRM-to-ERP system flow prior to deal closure.
Bookings Reporting and Compliance: Oversee corporate bookings metrics and reporting, ensuring accurate application of internal bookings policies.
Cross-Functional GTM Partnership: Partner closely with Go-To-Market teams—including Professional Services, Deal Desk, Order Management, Legal, and FP&A—to support deal structuring, resolve billing and downstream revenue issues, and improve Contract-to-Cash velocity.
System Automation & Process Optimization: Identify, prioritize, and lead initiatives to enhance revenue systems, including CRM to ERM automation and business process enhancements.
Enterprise Tech Stack Mastery: Develop deep operational expertise in our ERP and CRM environments (Workday, Salesforce, and related systems), providing guidance on system usage, troubleshooting integration issues, and supporting scalable data design.
Special Projects Leadership: Lead and contribute to revenue-related special projects, including new product rollouts, CRM/ERP upgrades, policy rollouts, and GTM-led transformation efforts.
Audit Readiness: Manage and support external audit activities related to revenue operations and contract-to-cash, serving as a key point of contact to ensure timely, data-backed, and accurate responses.
Team Mentorship & Growth: Coach and mentor revenue accounting team members, supporting skill development, knowledge sharing, and consistent execution of operational best practices.
Anaplan Integration: Complete Anaplan training and contribute to the enhancement and ongoing development of internally used Anaplan models to drive better automated reporting and forecasting.
Your Qualifications
Experience: 8+ years of progressive revenue accounting and revenue operations experience, with strong expertise in ASC 606; public SaaS company and/or fast-growing enterprise software experience strongly preferred.
Systems Expertise (Strongly Preferred): Hands-on, administrative-level or power-user experience with Workday and Salesforce, including a proven track record of managing CRM-to-ERP integrations.
CPA or equivalent certification is a plus
Operational Analytical Skills: Proven ability to interpret complex contract terms and business requirements and translate them into scalable, automated operational workflows in our systems.
Process Builder Mindset: Demonstrated experience leading process improvement initiatives that reduce manual Excel work, deepen analytical understanding, and streamline operational accounting workflows.
Collaboration & Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between GTM teams (Professional Services/Deal Desk) and Accounting to influence operational outcomes without direct authority.
Resilience in Growth: Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving processes and integrated enterprise systems.
People Leadership: 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring a team of direct reports.

reporting, while also collaborating with Operations leadership to drive

description_text:
About Zipline
Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. 
Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.
Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.
We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.
About You and The Role 
Zipline is seeking a Manufacturing Finance Partner to join our Strategic Finance team to help make manufacturing performance measurable, explainable, and economically actionable as we prepare for hyperscale. As manufacturing expands rapidly over the coming years, this role will help build the financial operating lens needed to scale with that growth. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys translating operational reality into financial insight. You will partner closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Operations, and Accounting to establish cost truth, improve inventory and cash visibility, create actionable variance analysis, and build the reporting cadence that helps leaders make sharper scaling decisions. You will be successful here if you can thrive in a fast-changing manufacturing environment while knowing what great looks like in the future. The work is not just reporting the numbers; it is helping lead the team from evolving systems and processes toward a scaled operating model with clear ownership, reliable data, and decision-quality economics.
What You'll Do 
Own manufacturing finance reporting, forecasting, and variance analysis across cost, labor, inventory, cash, and operating expense.
Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Operations, and Accounting to understand performance drivers and turn them into clear business actions.
Build financial models and decision support for product cost, production planning, capacity, cost-down initiatives, make-buy analysis, and manufacturing investments.
Develop dashboards, reporting, and operating cadences that give leaders better visibility into manufacturing performance and unit economics.
Analyze key operational drivers such as labor efficiency, material usage, rework, scrap, yield, throughput, WIP, E&O, and production volume.
Improve the data, systems, and processes that support scalable manufacturing finance, including ERP, inventory, and operational reporting workflows.
What You'll Bring
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
Approximately 3+ years of experience in Manufacturing Finance, FP&A, Operations
Finance, Cost Accounting, Supply Chain Finance, or another analytical finance role.
Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial statements, and operational performance drivers.
Experience analyzing manufacturing, hardware, supply chain, inventory, or other operational cost drivers.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including financial modeling and scenario analysis.
Experience working with ERP, MRP, MES, inventory, or operational data systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Zerp, or similar tools.
Ability to work with large datasets, identify the business drivers behind the numbers, and communicate findings clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Strong problem-solving skills, high ownership, and the ability to operate effectively when processes and data are still evolving.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in high-growth hardware, aerospace, robotics, automotive, consumer electronics, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex operational environments.
Familiarity with SQL, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics and business intelligence tools.
Experience with inventory analysis, WIP, E&O, cycle counts, rework, scrap, yield, throughput, or capacity planning.
Experience supporting manufacturing cost reduction, product cost modeling, make-buy decisions, or supplier cost analysis.
Familiarity with standard costing, expected cost models, BOM governance, or cost accounting concepts.
Experience partnering with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, Accounting, and systems teams.
Passion for building scalable processes, improving data quality, and turning ambiguity into operating clarity.
You'll Be Successful If You 
Enjoy understanding how products are built and how operational decisions affect cost, throughput, and cash.
Naturally ask "why" when performance moves, and can separate symptoms from root causes.
Can distinguish factory-owned execution from upstream design, supplier, quality, or launch-related drivers.
Build strong relationships across Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and Accounting.
Can independently investigate messy operational data and turn it into practical recommendations.
Balance analytical rigor with business judgment and a bias toward action.
Thrive in environments where the right answer requires building the model, improving the process, and tightening the data at the same time.
Take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to make recurring finance processes more scalable.
What Else You Need To Know
The starting cash range for this role is $130,000 - $185,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

description_text:
SUMMARY: The Staff Accountant will assist with the overall integrity,
completeness and accuracy of the financial results and safeguarding of plant
assets. Responsible for general ledger accounting duties such as
entering/posting journal entries, reconciliation of bank and other accounts,
funding of cash transfers, while maintaining segregation of duties.  

  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: This list is not intended to be
all-inclusive, and other duties may be assigned. 

  

 * Maintain and bill records for outside warehouses. Prepare and update
   inventories for outside storage and report on a weekly and monthly basis. 

 * Clear accounts receivable as payments made to the Company. 

 * Maintain proper supporting documentation for record retention. 

 * Maintain accounting worksheets and files on accounting shared drive. 

 * Participate in the Company processes related to sales and use tax, hog/trade
   payables, fixed assets, asset tracking and inventory pricing. 

 * Ensures all negotiated contracts are paid as all parties involved have agreed
   upon; ensure vendor discounts are taken. 

 * Review and post cost accounting transactions and inventory transactions,
   including tracing the costs for financial reporting purposes. 

 * Become cross-trained on other functions of the department. 

 * Review of vendor statements to identify outstanding issues or credits for the
   company to take. 

 * Assist in the Financial Reporting cycle and month-end closing process by
   preparing accounting schedules, account reconciliation, journal entries,
   preparation of financial statements by entering data into trial balance
   worksheets.  

 * Perform trade A/P vendor set-up and/or change master file for existing vendor
   when primary contact is unavailable. 

 * Assist in performing other routine and non-routine accounting tasks and
   special projects and audits, including end of year physical inventory count.
   Duties are subject to change. 

 * Aid with applying principles and techniques of accounting to systematically
   process, verify, document, analyze and record financial data in accordance
   with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and/or Company
   policies. 

  

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must
be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed
below are representative of the work environment, knowledge, skill, and/or
ability required or preferred.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable
individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

  

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: A bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or
university in accounting is required. Must be a detail-oriented, effective
performer, who can operate within strict timelines and adapt to a fast-paced,
multi-task environment. Must be self-motivated and able to work with other team
members and motivate direct reports. 

  

COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Must have excellent written and verbal communication
skills.  Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals,
professional journals, technical procedures, and/or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to effectively
present information and respond to questions from management and employees. 
Must have the ability to influence and persuade others. 

  

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read and interpret documents in the English language
such as safety files and procedure manuals.  Must be able to effectively
communicate with outside vendors, senior management, peers, customers and others
within and outside of the organization. 

  

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to apply mathematical accounting concepts to
practical situations.  Must possess strong analytical and metric-based skills. 

  

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts,
and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of
technical instructions in mathematical, diagram, written and/or verbal form and
deal with several abstract and concrete variables. 

 

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: The employee needs to have experience with using
personal computers and Microsoft Software (WORD, EXCEL and POWERPOINT).
Experience with accounting systems is preferred. The ability to learn and
effectively use any and all other computer programs that are or will be made
available. The ability to be flexible in work duties and to expand knowledge of
the work area. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships
with all levels of the plant production team. Must hold a valid driver’s license
due to regular business travel. 

 

MISSION, VISION, & VALUES: Must believe and lead STF’s MISSION of producing
quality pork products, igniting the passion and growth of our team members,
helping our community thrive, and making our business prosperous. Remembering
that together we will achieve more by working safely and cultivating an
inclusive and empowering environment.  Must believe and fully engage in STF’s
VISION of being a place where we all belong, working as one, to build our
future. Must live STF’s VALUES in all decisions, behaviors, and interactions,
which include-  

SAFETY- Be committed to the safety and welfare of all employees through
prevention, education, and awareness, with the ultimate goal of eliminating
workplace accidents.  

QUALITY- Our customers and families depend on us to provide a safe, quality
product, by maintaining the highest food safety standards and desired customer
specifications. Must take pride in the products we produce and serve.  

DIVERSITY- We embrace diversity, experience, and thought, and actively strive
for inclusive behaviors across our company and our work. By promoting these
values, we aim to create a positive work experience that encourage a sense of
belonging.   

COMMUNITY- Be a positive representative of STF in our community while supporting
the organizations who work for the betterment of Siouxland.   

SUSTAINABILITY- Be a steward of the earth by managing our environmental
footprint.  

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is
frequently required to talk or hear.  Generally, the incumbent must be able to
sit and use a computer for extended periods of time.  The employee frequently is
required to stand; walk; move about the facility; use hands to finger, handle or
feel; and reach with hands and arms.  Specific vision abilities required by this
job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision,
depth perception and ability to adjust focus.  This position requires the
ability to occasionally lift office products and supplies, up to 20 pounds.

title: Lead Financial Analyst, Global Service Operations
ai_core_responsibilities: The Lead Financial Analyst serves as a strategic partner to Global Service Operations, managing financial models for cost-to-serve, inventory, and field productivity. This role translates operational data into actionable insights while driving process improvements and automation across the finance team.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting and at least 8 years of relevant financial experience. Proficiency in financial modeling, US GAAP, and ERP systems like Oracle or Hyperion is required.
description_text:
The Lead Financial Analyst, Global Service Operations will be a strategic
finance partner to Global Service Operations, Service Supply Chain and Field
Service leadership.

This role connects operational performance to financial outcomes, providing the
analysis and insights needed to improve cost, productivity, working capital and
service margin. The Lead Analyst owns key financial models and processes across
cost to serve, Service COGS, inventory and field productivity, and serves as a
trusted financial advisor to operations leadership.

The role combines deep financial analysis with business partnership,
cross-functional problem solving and process improvement, while also helping
strengthen analytical capabilities across the broader finance team.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 * Serve as the primary financial partner to Global Service Operations, Service
   Supply Chain and Field Service leadership, translating operational and
   financial data into insights, recommendations and actions.
 * Own worldwide cost-to-serve and Service COGS analytics, including cost by
   asset age, system type, region and customer; annual labor-rate updates;
   gross-margin and cost-to-serve reporting; and a robust forecast and budget
   process leveraging installed base, coverage and operational drivers.
 * Lead service parts and working-capital analytics, including parts consumption
   and work-order trends, inventory value, days in inventory and turnover. 
 * Connect field-service productivity to financial performance through
   utilization, capacity and productivity analytics that help leadership
   understand cost, resource requirements and margin implications.
 * Partner across Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Service Engineering and
   Accounting on key financial processes and business decisions, including
   Integrated Business Planning and the tracking, forecasting and true-up of
   quality field-action reserves.
 * Own the operations and cost narrative for monthly business reviews and
   executive presentations, providing meaningful variance analysis, identifying
   key performance drivers and clearly articulating risks, opportunities and
   forward-looking implications.
 * Develop business cases and track benefits realization for cost-efficiency,
   productivity, inventory reduction and value-capture initiatives, helping
   ensure financial outcomes are understood and sustained.
 * Drive automation, advanced modeling and continuous improvement across
   financial reporting and analysis, creating scalable tools and processes that
   improve accuracy, efficiency and decision support.
 * Mentor and support the development of other analysts and lead
   cross-functional financial projects requiring coordination across multiple
   stakeholders and deadlines.

 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each
essential duty exceptionally.  The requirements listed below are representative
of the basic knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required:

 * Highly motivated individual with advanced financial acumen, analytical and
   problem-solving skills
 * Proven ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines and deliver results
   in a fast-paced, evolving environment, working effectively across
   cross-functional teams and influencing at all levels of the organization
 * Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to
   distill complex financial data into key insights for non-financial audiences
 * Advanced expertise in financial modeling, data manipulation (Microsoft
   Excel), accounting principles and US GAAP
 * Commitment to learning, growth mindset and focus on automation; track record
   of consistently high-quality, low-error work, using checks and
   reconciliations to self-catch issues before deliverables are shared

 

Education and experience requirements:

 * Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or related field required; Master’s
   degree or relevant certification a plus
 * 8+ years related financial experience
 * Experience with Oracle, Hyperion or similar ERP and planning platforms.
 * Experience with cost accounting, standard cost, inventory or manufacturing
   finance strongly preferred

 The annualized base salary range for this role is $ 93,600 – $146,400 and is
bonus eligible. Final compensation packages will depend on factors such as
experience, skills, knowledge, location, education, business needs, and market
demand.

 

 * Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:
 * Agencies that submit a resume to Hologic must have a current executed Hologic
   Agency Agreement executed by a member of the Human Resource Department. In
   addition, Agencies may only submit candidates to positions for which they
   have been invited to do so by a Hologic Recruiter.  All resumes must be sent
   to the Hologic Recruiter under these terms, or they will not be considered.

 

 * Hologic, Inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer inclusive of
   disability and veterans.
 * #LI-JW2
 * Must follow all applicable FDA regulations and ISO requirements.
 * Hologic is an equal opportunity employer inclusive of female, minority,
   disabled and veterans, (F/M/D/V)

title: Accounting Intern
