Candidates should understand basic accounting, be proficient in Excel and Microsoft Office, communicate professionally, work accurately with numerical data, and maintain confidentiality.
description_text:
Description
Episcopal SeniorLife Communities Mission:
We provide high quality services from skilled nursing and restorative care to housing, assisted living and community-based wellness programs. We are committed to meeting each individual’s needs, in a culturally competent manner, supporting family and loved ones through transitions, and fulfilling our pledge… Life. Inspired Every Day.

Accounting Intern 
Starting Pay Rate: $20.00/hour OR for academic credits
Schedule: 15 - 20 hours per week
This internship provides hands-on experience in accounting operations, with a focus on accounts payable, cash receipt entries, account reconciliations, and the accurate, timely distribution of data. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and committed to fostering a positive workplace culture. All responsibilities must be performed with strict confidentiality.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Record deposit activity for month-end posting and reconciliation.
Prepare and record journal entries for miscellaneous cash receipts.
Prepare monthly and quarterly account reconciliations for bank accounts, receivables, and other liability accounts.
Research and resolve reconciling items.
Compile information and prepare spreadsheets to assist finance department and outside auditors in internal and external statement preparations.
Assist the Controller/Asst Controller to update policies and procedures.
Ensure proper filing of documents.
Assist with data entry, filing and clerical support as needed.
Act as backup for Accounts Payable and Payroll Administrator positions.
Maintain fixed assets, purchase orders, company credit card system, and other duties as assigned.
General Professionalism & Skills:
Demonstrates behaviors consistent with the ESLC mission and values, including trust, integrity, respect, and a focus on quality in interactions with staff, residents, and community members.
Supports diversity, equity, and inclusion for all individuals.
Manages time independently to complete assignments.

Requirements
QUALIFICATIONS: 
Excellent interpersonal communication and customer service skills.
Demonstrated computer efficiency (Excel and Microsoft Office Programs).
Ability to interact courteously and tactfully with staff, residents, family members, visitors, vendors and the general public.
EDUCATION:
High School Diploma or GED required
Current 2nd or 3rd year college student making progress toward a bachelor’s degree in Finance
Accounting or Business Administration.
EXPERIENCE:
Understanding of basic bookkeeping and accounting principles.
Proficiency in Excel and MS Office Products.
Ability to perform detailed work with written or numerical data, and to make mathematical calculations accurately. 
High degree of accuracy and attention to detail required.
Ability to develop and maintain professional and administrative relationships necessary within a business environment.
Ability to maintain appropriate confidentiality with access to sensitive payroll and resident business.
Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
Professional attitude and appearance appropriate for office standards and responsibilities.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Performing duties of this job requires prolonged sitting, occasional walking and standing. Must be able to occasionally lift loads of 30 pounds without assistance and the ability to sit, talk, and hear is required. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

description_text:
Lifesteps in Butler, PA is hiring a full-time Accountant to assist the Fiscal and Accounting Department with preparing financial records and reports.

Lifesteps is a non-profit, human services organization which has been serving Western Pennsylvania for over 100 years by “helping individuals and families with life's changing needs”. The Agency provides programs and services to help children, adults, seniors and those with special needs live to their fullest potential. If you have a strong desire to help others and serve the community, this could be the right opportunity for you.   

The Accountant is responsible for the preparation and proofing of financial records and documents.  The Accountant performs efficient and accurate data entry into the Micro Information Processing (M.I.P.) Accounting System.     The part-time hours will be during the week (Monday thru Friday) and can be up to 19 hours per week.    

JOB DUTIES  MAY INCLUDE:

 * Manage accounting transactions and assist with bookkeeping
 * Prepare budget forecasts
 * Assist with creation of financial statements 
 * Handle monthly, quarterly and annual closings
 * Assist with reconciling accounts payable and receivable
 * Ensure timely bank payments
 * Assist with computing taxes and prepare tax returns
 * Manage balance sheets and profit/loss statement




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:  

 * Associates Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Management or related field with 4 years of related experience
 * OR Bachelors Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Management or related field with 1 year of related experience
 * Excellent thought processing, and organizational skills with attention to detail. 
 * Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.  

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 * Accounting software experience such as Abila M.I.P.




Apply Today!

title: Finance Director
ai_core_responsibilities: The Finance Director oversees the organization's financial activities, including budgeting, financial reporting, and forecasting. They also manage internal controls, cash and investment activities, and provide financial guidance to department heads.
ai_requirements_summary: Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Accounting, or Finance. Prior management experience and advanced proficiency in Excel and accounting software are required.
description_text:
Your experience matters 

 

HSHS Green Bay is part of Lifepoint Health
[https://lifepointhealth.net/locations], a diversified healthcare delivery
network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment
to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As
a Director of Finance joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission
dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey
where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference
in the lives of those we serve.

 

Why join us 

 

Fundamental to providing great care is supporting and rewarding our team. In
addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:  

 * Health (Medical, Dental, Vision) and 401K Benefits for full-time employees
 * Competitive Paid Time Off 
 * Employee Assistance Program – mental, physical, and financial wellness
   assistance
 * Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance for qualified applicants
 * And much more...

 

How you’ll contribute 

 

The Finance Director directs financial activities of the organization. Establish
or recommend management, major economic objectives and policies for company.
Prepare reports which summarize and forecast company business activity and
financial position in areas of income, expenses and earnings based on past,
present and expected operations. Responsible for preparation of annual hospital
budget. Advise management on desirable operational adjustments due to budget
constraints and changes in hospital reimbursement. Supervise preparation of
schedules and other documentation for audits of company’s accounts.

 

Essential Functions:

 * Direct and participate in the development of accounting and internal control
   policies and systems.

 * Coordinate and control the facility’s cash and investment management
   activities.

 * Provide advice and assistance to department heads and managers in analyzing
   and interpreting financial data and reports and in presenting that
   information to their departments.

 * Define and communicate new/revised position responsibilities and/or reporting
   relationships and determine necessary staffing changes.

 * Ensure that accurate information is provided on a timely basis and assists,
   as needed, in facilitating the efficient conduct of external audits,
   examinations and related financial projects.

 * Ensure that a monthly time schedule is established for the processing of
   computer reports necessary for the preparation of monthly financial
   statements; implements corrective action as necessary to meet established
   deadlines.

 * Consistently develop a detailed plan of action prior to implementation of a
   new procedure.

 * Regularly examine alternative methods of providing required accounting
   services in order to reduce departmental operating costs.

 * Promote good staffing practices by maximizing the utilization of human
   resources; forecasts and anticipates the personnel needs of the department
   with regard to fluctuations in the projected workload; holds staffing at a
   functional minimum.

 * Consistently demonstrate the ability to establish appropriate departmental
   priorities.

 * Consistently complete all assignments in a timely manner, thorough and
   appropriately detailed.

 * Demonstrate effectiveness in pulling together all the necessary information
   needed to compare revenue and expenses and determine the facility’s actual
   financial position.

 * Effectively maintain all required records for the department; demonstrates
   good organizational skills.

 * Monitor the implementation of checks and balances which continually evaluate
   accounting practices, reporting procedures and record keeping.

 * Other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications & Requirements: 

 * Education: Bachelors in Business, Healthcare Administration, Accounting,
   Finance or similar required.

 * Prior management experience preferred.

 * Excellent computer knowledge. 

 * Advanced Excel user.

 * Excellent knowledge of accounting software packages and spreadsheets.

 * Extensive computer knowledge, particularly Excel.
 * Knowledge of basic equipment.

 * Appropriate telephone communication skills.
   
    

 

Schedule: Full Time 

 

EEOC Statement

 

HSHS Green Bay is an Equal Opportunity Employer. HSHS Green Bay is committed to
Equal Employment Opportunity for all applicants and employees and complies with
all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment in employment.

 


Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of
Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans
29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and
behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across
the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers
and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through
talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with
opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a
difference in communities across the country.
We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to
promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with
an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and
reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.

description_text:
Save the Children 

As the world changes, our mission stays the same. At Save the
Children, you’ll join a century-long legacy of integrity, accountability, and
commitment to children. We value your curiosity and drive to learn, which is why
we invest in your growth and empower you to innovate, collaborate, and create
lasting impact for children. Together, we’re building a culture of belonging
that shapes a better future—for children and for each other. 

The Role 

The Senior Director of Payroll is a hands on, player/coach role within Save the
Children, overseeing all aspects of payroll strategy and operations for entities
within the United States, including international expatriates and third-country
nationals working abroad.

Reporting to the Head of HR Operations and Employee Experience, you will ensure
accurate, compliant, and timely payroll processing across the organization and
serve as a key strategic partner to Human Resources, HRIS, Finance, and IT. You
will lead the internal payroll team and manage external payroll vendors to
deliver scalable, high-quality payroll services aligned with business
objectives. You will be responsible for ensuring that Agency transformational
projects that involve the payroll processes conform to regulatory and policy
requirements while maximizing technical efficiencies and keeping data secure.

Location 

Hybrid – Washington DC, Fairfield, CT or Lexington, KY office locations 

What You’ll Be Doing (Essential Duties)

*NOT INCLUSIVE OF ALL ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES. MAY BE SUBJECT TO CHANGE 

Payroll Operations 70%

 * Oversee day-to-day operations of the payroll team and processes associated
   with payroll, payroll tax, wage garnishments, and related transactions for
   three entities.
 * Administer payroll for international expatriates and third country nationals
   working abroad including ensuring that international living allowance
   compensation is complete and accurate.
 * Ensure pay is completely and accurately transmitted to banks as required
   including international wire payments.
 * Assess payroll-related operations and identify areas to incorporate
   automation or improve efficiencies.
 * Collaborate closely with Benefits team on deduction processing, benefits
   reconciliation, and leave related pay impacts.
 * Serve as the payroll subject matter expert for federal, state, and local paid
   leave programs, including Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML), state
   disability insurance programs, paid sick leave requirements, and wage
   replacement benefits. Partner with Benefits, HR, and leave administrators to
   ensure accurate employee payments, deductions, tax treatment, reporting, and
   regulatory compliance.
 * Oversee the payroll help desk along with resolution of complex payroll
   issues, employee concerns and inquiries and resolves errors related to
   payroll processing, deductions, or special pays.
 * Manage payroll to banks’ reconciliation processes, payroll general ledger
   reconciliation, payroll year end process, and review of audit reports and
   inquiries; ensures correction of payment issues prior to closing payroll.
 * Lead payroll audits, support financial statements and all prepare reporting
   and information for audits involving payroll.
 * Support and monitor the annual payroll team budget, working with leadership
   to forecast payroll-related expenses.
 * Serve as subject matter expert in payroll related matters on all projects
   that impact payroll and timekeeping and lead change management activities to
   drive user adoption.
 * Build and maintain communication and training for employees.
 * Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements for federal, state, and local
   tax and payroll regulations, including year-end W-2 filings and corrections.
 * Produce relevant payroll-related reporting and manage maintenance of all
   payroll/timekeeping internal processes, procedures, and policies.
 * Support accounting with closing activities related to staffing costs,
   including month-end and year-end close.

Platform and Vendor Management 20%

 * Lead and manage relationships with external payroll vendors, tax providers,
   and third-party administrators.
 * Oversee vendor performance, service-level agreements (SLAs), issue
   resolution, and continuous improvement
 * Make recommendations, and in review and consideration for new payroll
   platforms along with acting as subject matter expert when systems that
   interact with payroll platforms are being considered for the agency.
 * Support vendor implementations, transitions, and contract negotiations as
   needed.

Payroll Team Leadership 10%

 * Train, develop, coach, lead, and supervise staff, clearly communicating
   organization, division and department priorities, and how their work
   contributes to our mission, ensuring that the working environment continually
   fosters diversity, inclusion, and belonging – supporting Save the Children
   values
 * Provide coaching, performance feedback, and career development opportunities
   for payroll staff.
 * Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex payroll
   matters.
 * Lead cross-functional collaboration in challenging payroll scenarios,
   fostering calm, transparent communication and coordinated problem-solving to
   minimize employee impact and maintain trust.
 * Remain current in current industry trends related to payroll.

Required qualifications for the role 

 * Minimum of a Bachelor Degree or equivalent experience, plus at least 7 years
   of Payroll experience with 3 years in a supervisory role.
 * Experience administering payroll within a complex multi-state environment,
   including state paid leave programs and related regulatory requirements.
 * Deep knowledge of federal, state, and local tax regulations related to
   payroll.
 * Demonstrated success managing payroll vendors and third party providers
 * Experience with time & attendance and payroll software, UKG and Tenrox a plus
 * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 * Ability to work independently, with minimal guidance, and manage multiple
   priorities.
 * Ability to acts as a resource for colleagues as a payroll subject matter
   expert.
 * Strong understanding of federal and state payroll compliance laws.
 * Strategic, lateral thinking and ability to translate findings into pragmatic
   solutions.
 * Strong analytical capabilities with experience leveraging payroll and
   workforce data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
 * Experience with leave management administration, state paid leave programs,
   or integrated leave and payroll solutions.
 * Critical reasoning and demonstrated ability to solve complex business
   problems through resourcefulness
 * Professional proficiency in MS Office suite, and with advanced Excel skills
 * Professional proficiency in spoken and written English

Preferred qualifications for the role 

 * Experience supporting payroll operations across non-profit or multi-entity
   organizational structures.
 * Payroll platform implementation as it relates to HCM systems.
 * Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification
 * International development payroll processing experience
 * Project management experience
 * Understanding of payroll accounting
 * Experience supporting payroll in a shared services or matrixed organization

dependent on candidate location:

Description
About AMBA
Since 1981, AMBA has been a trusted provider of essential coverage for retired public servants nationwide. Our reach extends to diverse groups, including hardworking public employees, state retirees, educators, military personnel, trade professionals, firefighters, law enforcement, Unions, Alumni groups, Allied Healthcare, and other non-profit associations. As a full-service marketing and membership development company, we proudly offer outstanding insurance services to our vast network of 44 million members across 450+ associations in all 50 states. 

About the Role
Finance Analysts on the Operational Finance team support AMBA’s sales organization by ensuring accurate and timely reporting on marketing spend and sales performance across multiple distribution channels. This role is responsible for the monthly marketing close, recurring KPI and scorecard reporting, and finance support for sales and call center teams. Finance Analysts collaborate with marketing, sales leadership, and Accounting to track results against budget and identify opportunities for cost savings. As an individual contributor, a Finance Analyst applies financial knowledge and analytical skills to deliver insights, while continuing to develop expertise through collaboration with managers and senior team members.

The Day-to-Day
• Reconcile direct mail and digital marketing invoices monthly, confirming with marketing teams that vendor invoices and related entries reach Accounting.
• Prepare accrual entries for invoice-timing differences and report actuals against forecast and budget, with commentary on variance drivers.
• Produce monthly operating KPI reporting, including call volume, conversion rates, lead counts, headcount, hires, and terminations.
• Build and distribute weekly sales scorecards tracking production and incentive standings.
• Partner with call center teams on performance tracking and the monthly incentive cycle.
• Create and maintain reporting and forecasting models, including sales expense and production forecasts.
• Review business trends and partner with sales and marketing leaders on their monthly results for operation optimization and cost savings.
• Support ongoing initiatives to automate, improve, and streamline the analysis and reporting processes.
• Other duties as assigned.

Requirements
Requirements and Qualifications
• 3–5 years of experience in financial analysis, sales or marketing finance, or FP&A (preferred); insurance or multi-channel sales experience a plus.
• Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field.
• Working knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), including accruals and month-end close.
• Advanced Excel skills, including building models with lookups, pivot tables, and multi-source workbooks.
• Comfort pulling data from databases and reporting environments; experience with SQL, Power BI, or similar tools (preferred).
• Demonstrated critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and keen attention to detail.
• Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills for interaction with teams and senior leadership.
• Ability to meet recurring deadlines and follow through on inputs from teams outside finance.
• Ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to change, and work effectively across teams.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office products; Oracle NetSuite or Hyperion Essbase experience (preferred).

commitments. The role builds and challenges financial cases for acquisitions, licenses, Royalty-Backed
Guarantees, financing structures, and other content investments so decision-makers understand expected return,
downside exposure, cash timing, recoupment, and key sensitivities before capital is committed.
Expectations at Angel Studios:
Amplify light in every action.
As the owner of your outcomes, you are empowered to break down silos and coordinate with any and all people you need in order to reach your goals. 
You are ultimately responsible for achieving the outcomes while also using resources wisely - whether that be money, people, or time.
Know your customer - it might be our viewers, investors, creators, or internal Angel Teams. Ensure you understand your customer and are providing what THEY need and not just what you want to build.

Essential functions
Investment Underwriting: Build decision models for acquisitions, licenses, RBGs, and strategic content investments.
RBG Analysis: Model guarantee exposure, timing, performance thresholds, downside cases, recoupment,interest, and cash requirements.
Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis: Pressure test audience, theatrical, Guild, downstream, licensing, cost, timing, and revenue assumptions.
Deal Economics: Model waterfalls, revenue shares, minimum guarantees, advances recoupment positions,financing fees, and return structures.
Decision Materials: Prepare clear investment memoranda and recommendations for Business Affairs andexecutive approval.
Portfolio Monitoring: Compare actual performance with approved underwriting cases and identify lessons for future investment decisions.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Finance, FP&A, Acquisitions, Guild, Theatrical, International, and Business Affairs to validate assumptions and data.
Capital Exposure Reporting: Maintain visibility into committed, contingent, and potential content obligations.
Competencies
Advanced financial modeling and investment analysis skills.

Ability to explain complex models and risks clearly to creative and executive stakeholders.
Strong skepticism, precision, and willingness to pressure test optimistic assumptions.

Job Description
NBCUniversal is looking for a Post Production Billing Manager! The Post Production Billing Manager is a key member of the Finance team supporting Studio Operations Post Production business (aka StudioPost). In this position you will oversee day-to-day billing operations, ensures timely and accurate customer invoicing, manages billing-related systems and processes, and partners with operational teams to resolve billing issues. You will also supervise billing and payroll support staff and plays an important role in the month-end close process.
What You’ll Do: 
Supervise staff composed of a Billing Clerk and Payroll Clerk
Serve as group billing lead managing all aspects of Sphere billing system
Manage automated billing exports from two departmental subsystems into the studio billing system, including reviewing and resolving interface errors and billing exceptions.
Respond to customer inquiries working closely with schedulers to resolve billing issues (SAP charge number, PO, invoice discrepancy) in a timely manner
Prepare and distribute recurring operational and financial revenue reports
Manage month-end close billing process notifying Schedulers and Billing Clerks of billing and accrual deadlines
Update and maintain services and rates in ScheduALL Sound subsystem
Provide documentation for internal and external audits
Support timekeeping and activities impacting Sphere deals
Qualifications
Let’s Talk About You…
Strategic Leader – You see the big picture and translate business objectives into scalable processes, controls, and service models that support Studio Post today and in the future.
Process Improvement Champion – You naturally identify inefficiencies, challenge outdated practices, and lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase accuracy, compliance, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
Data-Driven Decision Maker – You leverage financial, operational, and performance data to identify trends, assess risk, prioritize opportunities, and make informed recommendations.
Financial & Operational Acumen – You understand how operational decisions impact revenue, expenses, cash flow, customer satisfaction, and overall business performance, and you use that knowledge to drive better outcomes.
Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease
Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
Juggler – You know how to manage multiple tasks and priorities and move them all along effectively while keeping stakeholders updating and informed
What You Must Have:
3+ years of billing or related finance experience
High school diploma or equivalent
What Would Make You a Stand-out:
Entertainment or postproduction experience
B.S. degree in accounting or finance
Knowledge of SAP, ScheduALL, Sphere, Timekeeper
Demonstrated success leading process improvement, automation, standardization, and organizational change initiatives.
Proven ability to navigate complex business environments while balancing multiple priorities and driving results.
Collaborative leader with team-oriented approach to managing

description_text:
PAYROLL MANAGER

Volare Health | Corporate

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Volare Health is seeking an experienced Payroll Manager to lead and oversee the
day-to-day payroll function supporting multiple senior living communities.

This is a key leadership role responsible for the end-to-end payroll process,
including weekly payroll oversight, employee setup, payroll system
administration, payroll taxes, audits, compliance, reporting, and process
improvement. The ideal candidate is an experienced payroll professional who is
highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing a fast-paced,
multi-location payroll environment.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 * Lead the payroll team and oversee the complete payroll process from data
   entry through tax compliance.

 * Oversee and audit weekly payroll processing to ensure accuracy and
   timeliness.

 * Maintain and update payroll policies and procedures.

 * Direct the preparation, analysis, and processing of payroll data.

 * Ensure compliance with applicable federal and state wage, hour, payroll, and
   tax requirements.

 * Maintain payroll systems and collaborate with HR, Benefits, and Accounting to
   ensure accurate and effective payroll support.

 * Oversee employee setup and payroll system administration, including job
   titles, pay codes, locations, and GL accounts.

 * Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, reduce errors, and
   implement best practices.

 * Develop payroll metrics to measure departmental performance and costs.

 * Maintain accurate payroll records and reports and manage payroll audits.

 * Ensure the accuracy of direct deposits, taxes, garnishments, checks, and
   manual payroll calculations.

 * Calculate and process special payments including overtime, bonuses, vacation
   pay, and termination pay.

 * Train, develop, and manage payroll staff while supporting performance and
   professional growth.

 * Maintain strong internal controls and identify opportunities for increased
   efficiency.

 * Oversee year-end W-2 processing.

 * Manage payroll projects and annual departmental goals.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

 * Bachelor's degree in a related field.

 * 7+ years of progressive payroll experience.

 * Experience with ADP HRIS, specifically Workforce Manager (WFM) and Workforce
   Now (WFN).

 * Strong spreadsheet and database skills with the ability to extract and
   analyze information.

 * Strong mathematical and analytical skills.

 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 * Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.

 * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines.

 * Strong understanding of federal and state payroll and tax requirements.

Preferred:

 * Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation preferred, but not required.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Payroll is at the heart of the employee experience. In this role, you'll have
the opportunity to lead a critical corporate function, support employees across
multiple communities, strengthen payroll processes, and build efficiencies that
directly impact the organization.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving problems, and
understands that accuracy, compliance, and service are equally important in
payroll.


WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position supports fast-paced senior living environments operating 24 hours
a day, 365 days a year. The role may occasionally require extended days or
weekend work.

The position involves regular computer and office equipment use, prolonged
periods of sitting, and occasional lifting of up to 15 pounds. Reasonable
accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform
the essential functions of the position.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Volare Health is committed to maintaining a professional, respectful, and
inclusive workplace. Employees are expected to follow company policies and
procedures, protect confidential information, and support the organization's
commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

description_text:
JOB SUMMARY

Supports the company’s business objectives and leadership decision making by
preparing financial analyses and financial models and providing timely,
accurate, transparent and relevant financial information to key internal and
external stakeholders.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Supports budgeting, forecasting and financial planning processes for
   operating subsidiaries and consolidated holding companies.
 * Responsible for the collection, organization, and analysis of quantitative
   data used to develop financial projections.
 * Supports the maintenance and ongoing assessment of financial models including
   supporting model modifications and upgrades to improve accuracy of financial
   projections. 
 * Builds strong partnerships with leadership across the organization to make
   informed business decisions and provide end-to-end Finance support, including
   budgeting and forecasting, variance analysis, driving strategic initiatives,
   among other things.
 * Supports the development of complex financial scenarios, sensitivities and
   analyses related to special projects and ad hoc requests.
 * Assists in keeping a pulse on financial health and outlook of the business by
   measuring and monitoring actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and
   internal goals.  
 * Provide timely and meaningful analytical insights that drive financial
   results and support key decision making and corporate objectives. 
 * Supports the development of various financial reports and presentations for
   key internal and external stakeholders, including Senior Leadership Team and
   Board of Directors.
 * Collaborates with other members of the Finance & Treasury teams to implement
   best practices and develop new frameworks for analyzing the business.
 * Participate in cross-functional initiatives to improve processes, systems,
   and automation
 * Assists in the presentations and communicates financial forecasts and/or
   other financial results/analysis to peers and leadership.

 * Assists and supports various capital investment forecasts processes, treasury
   activities associated with cash operations and debt capital markets, and
   actual and projected revenue requirements calculations.
   
    

REQUIREMENTS

 * Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or relevant field of study 
 * Minimum of two (2) years of related financial analysis experience in budget
   development, financial modeling, or accounting.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 * Strong planning and organizational skills
 * Extremely detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy and precision  
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to relate
   directly, openly, and effectively with key stakeholders
 * Continuous improvement attitude; ability to think creatively; must have
   ambition to challenge the status quo
 * Highly driven and self-motivated; ability to work independently without
   prescriptive guidance
 * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously in
   a fast-paced environment
 * Highly collaborative and team-oriented, easily adapts to different work
   styles and environments. 
 * Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

Company Description
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.
As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.
We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.
This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.
We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.
Join us and let’s shape the future of data.
Job Description
This role requires a highly motivated and experienced accounting professional that can lead a team who can partner with operations to address complex transactions and oversee SEC and other external financial reporting. In this leadership role, you will develop and mentor your team, oversee preparation and filing of financial reporting with the SEC and other external parties, partner with other business functions on projects to address accounting and reporting implications for complex transactions, monitor developments at the SEC and FASB, and implement solutions to maintain effective and efficient processes and controls to support external reporting in compliance with applicable standards.
This position is best suited for an accounting professional who possesses strong communication, organization, technology and leadership skills as well as enjoys working in a challenging, fast-paced environment.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Oversee execution of periodic filings with the SEC; including financial statement preparation, related notes, Management Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations, and other applicable reporting obligations
Coordinate with our Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm on the execution of our annual audit and quarterly reviews, including liaising with general accounting and other business functions to ensure timely execution and completion
Collaborate with investor relations on financial presentations for communications with investors and related stakeholders.
Build and maintain relationships across functions, including business operations, general accounting, tax, treasury, legal, investor relations and HR to ensure timely communication and review of reporting matters
Monitor developments at the SEC and FASB for potential impacts on accounting or disclosure, educate the business on potential impacts, and partner with IT and other functions on any necessary system developments or process improvements
Prepare and present information as necessary to aid the Audit Committee in fulfillment of their oversight obligations
Act as a global technical lead on strategic transactions to identify accounting and reporting obligations or issues and assist with actions required for execution or implementation
Guide and motivate a team of accounting professionals to grow their career, including development of technical and presentation skillsets
Qualifications
Undergraduate Degree in Finance/Accounting (or equivalent experience) with knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting requirements with 10+ years of overall experience
Active CPA license
Demonstrated experience managing a team for 6+ years
Hands-on experience with filings of Form 10-K, 10-Q, Proxy, and other SEC filings associated with financial reporting
Experience with capital market transactions, including comfort letters and relevant SEC securities filings
Experience with multinational operations functioning in various currencies
Demonstrated experience with implementing new accounting pronouncements, as well as process and system automation
Experienced in leading cross-functional projects and related management presentations
Solid knowledge of Oracle ERP system and Workiva
Consistent record of accomplishment of establishing relationships with cross-functional business partners

description_text:
BILLING CLERK — ACCOUNTING DEPARTMENT | GRUBBS FAMILY OF DEALERSHIPS


ABOUT US

Grubbs Family of Dealerships is a multi-brand, family-owned automotive group with deep roots across the DFW Metroplex and the state of Texas. We’ve built our reputation on doing right by our customers and our people — and we’re looking for team members who share those values.

We invest in our people, provide real opportunities to grow, and take pride in the experience we deliver to both our customers and our team members. When you join Grubbs, you join a culture built on integrity, professionalism, and continuous improvement. We set a high bar — and we give you the training, tools, and support to clear it.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re seeking a detail-oriented Billing Clerk to support our accounting department. You’ll ensure deals and repair orders are billed accurately and on time, keeping our financial operation running cleanly. Accuracy, speed, and follow-through are non-negotiable in this role — your work keeps the entire store’s numbers clean.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 * Bill out new and used vehicle deals accurately and within the deadlines that keep gross recognized on time
 * Process repair orders, parts invoices, and related paperwork with complete accuracy
 * Verify documentation, costs, fees, and gross on every deal before posting — catching errors before they reach the schedule
 * Maintain organized, reconciled records and support an on-time, clean month-end close
 * Communicate proactively with sales, service, and F&I to resolve discrepancies quickly
 * Keep deal jackets and accounting paperwork complete, compliant, and audit-ready
 * Support the controller and office manager with schedules, reconciliations, and accounting tasks as needed


THE STANDARD WE HOLD

We set a high bar at Grubbs. In this role, success means consistently delivering on the following:

 * Deals and ROs billed accurately and on time — no aging in the wash-out
 * Clean schedules with errors caught before posting, not after
 * Reliable support of an on-time month-end close
 * Audit-ready, complete paperwork on every transaction
 * Discrepancies resolved quickly through clear communication


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 * Automotive dealership accounting or billing experience strongly preferred
 * Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers
 * Familiarity with DMS platforms (Tekion, CDK, Reynolds, etc.) a plus
 * Proficiency with Excel and general office software
 * Highly organized, dependable, and deadline-driven


WHY GRUBBS?

 * Stable, office-based role within a respected accounting team
 * Opportunity to grow within the business office
 * Family-owned, people-first culture — you’re not a number here
 * Health, dental, and vision benefits
 * 401(k) with company match
 * Paid time off
 * Employee vehicle purchase program


READY TO JOIN US?

If you work with urgency, take pride in doing things right, and want to build a career in the automotive industry with a team that has your back, we want to hear from you. Apply now and a member of our team will be in touch promptly.

description_text:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
The Role
Cash App Investing is seeking a Compliance Officer to lead and mature the compliance program for its FINRA/SEC-regulated investing business. Reporting to the Head of Global Regulated Entities at Block, you will provide senior compliance leadership across broker-dealer obligations, product advisory, regulatory engagement, governance, and team execution. This role will partner closely with Cash App Investing leadership, Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Financial Crimes, Operations, and Internal Audit to support responsible growth and strong regulatory outcomes.
You Will
Lead the Cash App Investing compliance program, including policies, procedures, controls, monitoring, testing, reporting, and governance.

Advise Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Legal, and business leaders on investing product development, customer communications, and regulated activities.

Lead or support FINRA, SEC, state, and other regulatory exams, inquiries, responses, remediation plans, and regulator engagement.

Lead and develop a compliance team with clear ownership, sustainable coverage, and strong accountability.
You Have
10+ years of compliance experience, including significant experience in broker-dealer, securities, fintech, financial services, or similarly regulated environments.
Deep knowledge of FINRA and SEC requirements applicable to retail broker-dealers and digital investing platforms.
Experience serving in a senior compliance, chief compliance officer, deputy CCO, or comparable compliance leadership role.

Strong understanding of supervisory controls, written supervisory procedures, communications review, complaints, books and records, regulatory filings, and product compliance.

Series 7, Series 14, Series 63/65/66, or other relevant securities registrations.
Experience with mobile-first investing products, embedded financial services, clearing broker oversight, or fintech broker-dealer models.
Experience supporting Board-level governance and regulated-entity reporting.

description_text:
Job Description

Financial Analyst

 

Job Classification: Full Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Department: Finance & Accounting

Reports To: VP Controller

 

Job Overview

The Financial Analyst is responsible for performing the detailed analysis and research work necessary to understand the financial fundamentals of the Credit Union and plan for the future. The Financial Analyst works to understand the relationships and trends evident in the account and transaction data at BHCCU. Similarly the Analyst will manage the routine production of Asset/Liability Management data sets and reports that evaluate and describe interest rate risk. This individual will develop, maintain, and report on data included in profitability, investment, and budgeting models, and assist the department in all other matters as described below.

 

Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities

 * Data Analytics.
 * Help to manage and maintain financial reports and lead new dashboards. Asset/Liability Management.
   * Reconcile data to financial statements and Call Reports. Perform analysis designed to reveal levels of interest rate risk. Complete investment simulations as needed. .
   * Develop, maintain and organize reports for the Asset Liability Committee (ALCO).
   * Prepare the ALCO reporting package with assistance as needed. 
   * Ensure compliance with applicable policies. Specifically, ALM, Concentration Risk, and Liquidity and Contingency Funding Policies. 
 * Profitability
   * Develop and maintain product, branch, cost center, and department profitability models and reports.
 * Accounting
   * Assist with accounting functions as needed to facilitate the smooth operation of the accounting and finance team. This may include CECL, GL setup, money movement, reporting, reconciliations, processing, and/or exam deliverables. 
 * Budgeting
   * Assist as needed in the annual development of corporate and departmental budgets including income, expenses, and balance sheet growth.
 * Call Report
   * Assist as needed in the filing of the quarterly Call Report, including researching the appropriate values to report, confirming, reconciling, and entering the data, correcting errors, and filing with the state and NCUA.
 * Federal and State Exams
   * Assist in the research and preparation for State and Federal regulatory exams.
 * Securities Analysis
   * Perform analysis on current securities portfolio holdings and potential securities acquisitions. 
 * Rate Setting
   * Assist in the research necessary to determine appropriate interest rates and fees for all deposits, loans, and transaction accounts.
   * Research competitors in relevant markets to compare rates and fees.
 * Other
   * Provide financial analysis to other departments and committees as directed and assist other team members with finance questions.
   * Pursue the Chartered Financial Analyst designation, and attend conferences, workshops, and other training courses to increase technical and professional knowledge.
   * Take lead or participate in special projects directly related to the finance department and those of other departments. 
   * May be required to work in other departments within the Credit Union in positions for which the employee has previous experience or sufficient training, to maintain high levels of service to members.
   * Perform other work responsibilities as assigned by supervisor to facilitate smooth operation of the finance and accounting functions. 
 * Follow Processes and procedures established to ensure compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA). Complete required annual BSA training to ensure you understand your responsibilities that apply to BSA, including:
   * Understanding of BHCCU’s policies and procedures, as well as all rules and regulations which pertain to BSA. 




 * The above responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the person in this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, or working conditions. The VP Controller may assign other responsibilities as circumstances change.




QUALIFICATIONS and COMPETENCIES:




EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:




 * Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. 
 * Some experience in accounting, data analysis or finance preferred. 

 

COMPETENCIES:

 

 * Strong interpersonal skills, maturity and good judgment.
 * Must possess well-developed skills in verbal and written communication.
 * Role model of positive personal projection as demonstrated by professional appearance and attitude.
 * Comfortable working in a complex, highly competitive and rapidly changing environment. 
 * Ability to analyze and resolve situations independently.
 * Ability to manage multiple priorities, effectively delegate and set deadlines.
 * Ability to move new business practices from concept to reality.




OTHER (PHYSICAL, MENTAL AND VISUAL SKILLS):

 * Frequent periods are spent standing or sitting in the same location with some opportunity to move about; occasionally there may be a need to stoop or lift light objects (typically less than 8 pounds).
 * Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time. Intermittent physical activity including bending, reaching and prolonged periods of sitting. 
 * Ability to move about and communicate with a diverse membership and employee group.
 * Ability to accomplish the described responsibilities through the use of computers and technology.
 * Ability to work in a changing, challenging and fast paced environment with varying stress levels.
 * Must be able to lift 20lbs. occasionally.
 * Occasional travel required.

description_text:
Company Description
We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!
Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.
Our Mission
We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. We love to promote from within - more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs - they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!
Job Description
Summary Description 
This Director will lead Expeditors’ Central FP&A team with primary responsibility for the finance calendar, monthly forecast, annual operating plan, consolidated management reporting, and Board and earnings support. Reporting to the Vice President of FP&A, this person will be a close thought partner, turning the FP&A vision into repeatable processes and a single enterprise view of performance. The role is hands-on: the Director will build a small, focused team that leverages Expeditors’ existing regional controller network as it scales. 
We’re looking for someone who has seen strong FP&A in action and can adapt that experience to Expeditors rather than copy a playbook. The right person is curious about our business, practical in solving problems, comfortable in an evolving environment, and ready to turn ideas into action. 
What You Do 
Lead Planning, Forecasting and Management Reporting 
Lead monthly and quarterly forecasting, including timelines, assumptions, templates, consolidation, review, and communication. 
Work with regional controllers, business partners and Finance leaders to gather forecast inputs and understand the operational drivers and external factors behind performance. 
Facilitate constructive review and challenge of forecasts, helping leaders distinguish committed actions from known risks, potential opportunities, and longer-term aspirations. 
Own enterprise tracking of significant strategic initiatives, ensuring their expected financial impact is reflected in the plan and forecast. 
Evaluate forecast accuracy, identify recurring sources of variance, and improve forecasting methods over time. 
Lead monthly management reporting on results, drivers, risks, opportunities, and outlook, connecting financial outcomes to the operating activities and decisions behind them. 
Develop concise, executive-ready narratives on what changed, why it changed, and what actions or decisions may be required. 
Lead the annual operating plan and long-range planning processes with the Vice President and own the finance calendar that connects them with the forecast. 
Develop planning assumptions, templates, analytical methods, review materials, and quality standards. 
Develop scenarios that show the range of potential outcomes, key dependencies and risks, and the actions required to reach a preferred result. 
Translate company priorities into financial expectations, performance measures, and management actions.

description_text:
About Million Dollar Baby Co.
Million Dollar Baby Co. started in 1990 and is proudly family-owned and operated in Los Angeles. Since then, MDB has grown to 7 distinct brands of children’s furnishings ranging in style, aesthetic, and price, while carrying some of the industry’s most eco-conscious and award-winning designs. We can be found in retailers like Target and Amazon, and specialty retailers like Pottery Barn Kids and Crate & Barrel. 

Under the Million Dollar Baby Co. parent company are our family of brands: Babyletto, daVinci, Nursery Works, and Namesake. We’re proud to offer the most Greenguard Gold–certified cribs on the market and to use FSC-certified sustainable wood across our brands whenever possible. We’ve also pioneered Styrofoam-free packaging for several of our best-selling collections — an innovation that reduces waste while protecting our products during shipment.

At Million Dollar Baby Co., our team members are our #1 priority, and we partner with exceptional partners and retailers around the world who share our core values:

• Treat Your Team Like Family — lead with respect, gratitude, empathy, and kindness.
• Make an Impact, Drive Results — focus on meaningful work that moves families forward.
• Deliver a “Wow” Customer Experience Every Time — every detail matters.
• Strive for Continuous Improvement & Learning — keep growing, keep getting better.
• Cultivate Quality Conversations — communicate honestly and thoughtfully to build trust.

Over the years, our commitment to people, innovation, and a positive workplace culture has earned us five consecutive “Best Place to Work” awards, one of the best workplaces by “Built in LA”, a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor, and 13 years on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies list — recognitions that reflect the heart of who we are and the community we’re proud to build. We’d love to talk to you! 
Role Summary 
As an Accounts Payable & Receivable Specialist at Million Dollar Baby Co., you will play a pivotal role in managing the company’s financial transactions, from processing payments to handling incoming revenue. Your responsibilities will cover a broad range of financial activities, ensuring compliance with GAAP standards, managing both the accounts payable and receivable functions, and providing financial insights to guide business decisions. 
What You’ll Be Doing 
Accounts Payable Responsibilities: 
Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including processing vendor invoices, reviewing pending payments, and managing supplier relationships. 
Perform account reconciliations, variance analysis, and other regular closing tasks. 
Ensure the accuracy and regulatory compliance for tax filings and reporting. 
Prepare financial statements and assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting for management and external stakeholders. 
Prepare and assist with the annual audit process by liaising with external auditors. 
Complete General Ledger ownership, maintaining accuracy in all entries and reporting. 
Stay current on accounting regulations and legislation, ensuring compliance with GAAP standards. 
Accounts Receivable Responsibilities: 
Process and post daily incoming payments (Check, ACH, credit card, and Wire). 
Apply payments to corresponding invoices, maintaining accurate records of account balances. 
Provide collection assistance and resolve past-due discrepancies with customers. 
Manage all chargebacks and disputes for resolution, reconciling accounts as necessary. 
Send weekly statements to customers and provide AR reports for management review. 
Perform daily AR aging reviews and analysis, collaborating with the sales team for account reconciliation. 
What You Bring to the Table 
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance required. 
1-3 years of experience in an accounting role, preferably in accounts payable, receivable, or both, within wholesale distribution. 
Strong knowledge of GAAP standards and financial reporting. 
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software (Navision, Databricks, Sigma, and Concur experience a plus). 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
Sharp analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. 
Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy. 
Experience with Shopify and managing large accounts, a plus. 
California pay range
$30—$35 USD
Our Benefits:
100% of your health, dental and vision insurance monthly premiums paid by us! 
Flexible PTO because we respect the need for work/life harmony 
Company matching 401(k) 
Vacation reimbursement and wellness and enrichment subsidy programs 
Tuition reimbursement 
Matching charitable donations to the nonprofit organization of your choice 
Free MDB Co. swag + generous employee discount on products 
At Million Dollar Baby Co., we’re passionate about diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Our diversity, inclusion and equity committee (DIEC) strives to break barriers for minority communities, help educate the company on pertinent topics, and work to ensure equal opportunities for existing and potential employees. Since its formation in 2020, our committee has focused on multiple areas, some include hiring, community involvement and continuous learning about Diversity, Inclusion and Equity. 
Million Dollar Baby Company is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or recruitment process.

description_text:
Job Purpose:  

 

The Payroll Specialist administers the processing of the organization’s payroll for all business locations.  Collects payroll data to maintain accurate pay records and ensures accurate and timely processing of payments.  Works collaboratively with Human Resources, Operations and Finance to maintain clear processes and regulatory compliance.  

 

Responsibilities and Associated Duties:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 

 * Responsible for multi-state payroll of all employees for bi-weekly pay period.  Verify time entry for all employees in timekeeping software.  Review reports for exceptions. Quality check processed payroll reports for accuracy. Reconcile payroll prior to transmission and validate confirmed reports.
 * Ensure processing of pay rate and voluntary deduction changes for new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations. 
 * Processes manual checks such as terminations and discrepancies, stop payments and adjustments of payroll. 
 * Process garnishments
 * Processes special payrolls including the annual bonus and year-end adjustment payrolls. 
 * Processes end of month reporting for Accounting.
 * Researches and resolves questions from managers and employees as they relate to the processing of payroll information such as PTO, banking, garnishments, employment verifications, retroactive pay calculations, tax questions, and other changes. 
 * Provide wage reports for outside agencies as needed, including the timely submission of monthly and quarterly reports requested by US Labor and Statistics, the DOL, FL Department of Commerce, etc. 
 * Assist Accounting with unclaimed checks due diligence letters, reissues and reporting to proper state agency.
 * Process accurate and timely quarterly and year-end reporting (W-2s, etc.).  
 * Develop ad hoc financial and operational reporting as needed. 
 * Oversee the maintenance of current employee data systems. Manage workflow to ensure all payroll transactions are processed accurately and timely.
 * Support any internal and external audits related to payroll.
 * Other duties as assigned.

 

Knowledge, Experience and Skill Requirements:

 * Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) preferred.
 * 5 years of multistate payroll experience.
 * Knowledge of wage and hour laws for all applicable states, including California
 * Experience with ADP WFN and utilization of ADP comprehensive payroll
 * Proficient in Microsoft Office (high level of proficiency in Excel preferred) 
 * Attention to detail.
 * Highly organized, good time management
 * Ability to adapt to changes in the regulatory environment as appropriate.
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, ability to listen, understand and respond to customer needs.  Bi-lingual in Spanish is a plus.
 * Extreme confidentiality and integrity,
 * Ability to work with a variety of people.

description_text:
A Brief Overview

The Senior Accountant performs various duties to support the accounting
function's goal of timeliness and accuracy including preparation of journal
entries, budget comparison, and monthly financial reporting. The Senior
Accountant is responsible for ensuring proper accounting in accordance with
generally accepted accounting principles and reviewing financial reporting
packages to meet internal and external requirements as applicable. This position
is a member of the accounting team, and is accountable for meeting the deadlines
set by management, in order for the team to meet internal and external reporting
commitments to owners, partners, and lenders.  Role also includes responsibility
for supporting the Accounts Payable process through communications, monitoring
of AP related systems and intermittent AP tasks. This position supports
processes associated with the payment of invoices, receiving invoices and
communication with customers and vendors. 

What you will do

 * Prepares, reviews, and analyzes financial statements with referenced work
   papers and supporting schedules.
 * Reviews and evaluates implications of legal documents as they pertain to
   accounting transactions.
 * Prepares and reviews complex journal entries and coordinates the month-end
   closing process.
 * Records cash disbursements and receipts, prepares accrual entries, and
   reconciles general ledger account balances.
 * Assists with monthly, quarterly, and other special reporting requirements,
   including intercompany activity analysis and consolidation process.
 * Assists with external auditor requests.
 * Researches and documents GAAP accounting policies including writing memos to
   support accounting treatment for unique transactions as assigned.
 * Analyzes account balances and prepares variance explanations.
 * Assists in preparation of annual budgets.
 * Supervises and reviews delegated activities.
 * Serves as backup for department tasks.
 * Read and comprehend legal documents.
 * Prepare and gather support for interim and annual financial statement
   audits/reviews.
 * Work with other departments as needed (operations, asset management,
   corporate accounting, etc.)
 * Maintain projects and budgets within Workday including managing contracts and
   pay applications.
 * Monitors and directs communications addressed to Disbursements team.
 * Assists with monitoring and directing AP Processor workload.
 * Acts as liaison between vendors and company.
 * Monitors AP systems for exceptions and issues.
 * Provides user support for AP systems.
 * Assists in month end closing accruals.
 * Scrutinizes and maintains AP specific supporting documentation in accordance
   with company policy and tax requirements, specifically related to vendors,
   invoices, and payments.
 * Assists with AP related intermittent responsibilities including:
   * 1099 preparations
   * Unclaimed funds tracking and reporting
   * IRS levy responses
   * Vendor account reconciliations
   * Research
 * Stays up to date on 1099 requirements.
 * Train and assist with the on-boarding of AP related tasks for new employees.
 * Maintains, prepares, or reviews various AP specific reports and
   reconciliations.
 * Assists with implementing and maintaining policies, procedures, and systems
   to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the Accounts Payable process.
 * Assist with special projects as needed.

Qualifications

 * Bachelor's Degree in accounting Required
 * Minimum of 4 years of accounting experience, preferably corporate accounting,
   and reporting required.
 * Experience with Workday and/or other large ERP systems preferred.
 * Experience with legal document review, financial statements, generally
   accepted accounting principles, and internal control policies and procedures
   required
 * Must be able to work within specified deadlines.
 * Must be able to maintain confidentiality.
 * Ability to identify problems, collect and analyze data and draw logical
   conclusions.
 * Ability to multitask and work as part of a team to meet team goals in
   addition to individual responsibilities.
 * Requires a detail oriented, independent thinker who can be a part of a team
   and demonstrates strong attention to detail, and demonstrate knowledge of
   accounting practices and procedures.
 * Strong computer skills and proficiency with MS Office applications. Advanced
   working knowledge of MS Excel is required.
 * Excellent verbal & written communication skills.
 * Capable of prioritizing efficiently.
 * Requires a detail oriented, independent thinker who can be a part of a team
   and demonstrates strong attention to detail, and demonstrate knowledge of
   accounting practices and procedures.
 * Must demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and
   interpersonal skills, particularly the ability to communicate effectively
   with all levels of management and industry professionals.
 * Certified Public Accountant (CPA) Preferred

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive and equitable compensation. The hiring
range for this position is generally between $80,000 - $100,000, exclusive of
fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible for a
performance bonus. Final salaries will be determined based on factors such as

Range for the role. Hiring at the top of the range is reserved for exceptionally

Benefits

description_text:
Moneta is an independent Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) wholly focused on going further for our clients. We are one firm with many solutions and we provide a full spectrum of financial advisory services. Still, our true purpose is centered on building relationships and providing exceptional service to our clients around the globe. For that reason, we’ve built an entrepreneurial business model organized around our clients. Our Partner-led teams are empowered to serve only in the best interest of their clients. Plus, our independence means that we are never beholden to stakeholders or parent companies. We also have the unique ability to trace our history back nearly 150 years, demonstrating our ability to evolve to meet the needs of those we serve.

Job Summary

The Senior Financial Planning Analyst serves as a strategic modeling and forecasting expert for Moneta’s Enterprise Services Team (EST) and Partner Teams—playing a critical role in equipping the VP of Finance, COO, and Board of Directors with accurate, forward-looking insights for high-impact decision making.

In this role, you will design, build, and enhance complex financial models, lead multi-year budgeting and forecasting processes, and deliver clear, data-driven analysis that connects operational performance to financial outcomes. You will evaluate business trends, assess historical results, and anticipate future risks and opportunities, producing actionable recommendations that help guide enterprise-wide strategy.

This role blends technical modeling mastery, strategic thinking, and cross-functional collaboration, ensuring Moneta’s financial planning infrastructure remains scalable, insightful, and aligned with long-term business goals. You will contribute meaningfully to the evolution of Moneta’s planning ecosystem, including automation, new modeling architecture, and implementation of advanced planning tools.

Essential Responsibilities

 * Design, build, and maintain complex financial models from the ground up, supporting Partner Team life-cycle events including quarterly updates, PIT analysis, succession planning, scenario modeling, and ad-hoc strategic analysis.
 * Translate sophisticated modeling concepts into clear, actionable insights tailored to diverse audiences, including partner teams, senior leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.

diligence, funding approvals, and risk reporting, operating in a fast-paced

   protocols

   timeliness

   controls
 * Support new business initiatives by identifying control requirements and
   reporting implications

   portfolio as required

   senior leadership

   reporting standards and procedures
 * Identify process improvement opportunities and drive implementation to
   enhance operational efficiency

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

   discipline
 * Demonstrate 6+ years of progressive experience in Product Control, Financial
   Control, Accounting, or a related area
 * Apply strong analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail with a
   demonstrated control-oriented mindset
 * Communicate effectively across all levels and build strong working
   relationships with diverse stakeholders
 * Navigate fast-paced environments and adapt quickly to evolving priorities and
   business needs
 * Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and
   meeting deadlines
 * Operate independently with sound judgment and escalate issues appropriately

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

description_text:
Senior Payroll Specialist

ORGANIZATIONAL STRUCTURE: Reports to the Payroll Manager – Home Office

FLSA STATUS: Non-Exempt, Full Time

DEPARTMENT: Accounting

LOCATION: Lynnwood Home Office

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Payroll Specialist is a key member of the Zumiez Payroll Team and is
responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll for more than
9,000 employees in a high-volume, multi-state environment. This position
performs complex payroll transactions, payroll reconciliations, payroll tax
activities, and garnishment administration while ensuring compliance with
federal, state, and local regulations.

The Senior Payroll Specialist serves as a subject matter expert for payroll
operations, providing guidance and support to team members, resolving complex
payroll issues, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive process
improvements and operational excellence.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Process payroll accurately and timely in compliance with federal, state, and
   local regulations, company policies, and established payroll procedures.
 * Administer complex payroll transactions including retroactive adjustments,
   off-cycle payments, bonus payments, final pay calculations, and other
   variable compensation.
 * Manage wage garnishments, child support orders, tax levies, bankruptcies, and
   other involuntary deductions, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations
   and required remittances.
 * Research and resolve complex payroll issues, serving as an escalation point
   for payroll questions and employee concerns.
 * Reconcile payroll data, payroll reports, tax filings, deductions, and general
   ledger interfaces to ensure accuracy and completeness.
 * Review payroll audits and validation reports to identify discrepancies and
   correct issues prior to payroll processing.
 * Partner with Human Resources, Benefits, Finance, IT, and field management
   teams to resolve payroll-related issues.
 * Support payroll tax activities, including balancing, reporting, and issue
   resolution.
 * Develop, maintain, and update payroll process documentation and training
   materials.
 * Train and support payroll team members on payroll processes, system
   functionality, and compliance requirements.
 * Identify opportunities for process improvements, increased efficiency, and
   enhanced accuracy within payroll operations.
 * Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive employee and payroll
   information.
 * Perform other duties as assigned.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

 * Advanced payroll processing knowledge
 * Garnishment and payroll compliance expertise
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 * Attention to detail and accuracy
 * Effective communication and customer service skills
 * Process improvement mindset
 * Ability to prioritize and manage competing deadlines
 * Cross-functional collaboration and relationship building
 * Leadership through influence and knowledge sharing

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

 * 5+ years of payroll experience in a high-volume, multi-state environment.
 * Strong experience processing complex payroll transactions from end to end.
 * Demonstrated experience administering wage garnishments, child support
   orders, tax levies, bankruptcies, and other involuntary deductions.
 * Working knowledge of federal and state wage and hour laws, payroll tax
   regulations, and FLSA requirements.
 * Experience reconciling payroll reports, payroll tax data, deductions, and
   general ledger balances.
 * Proven ability to research, analyze, and resolve payroll discrepancies and
   employee pay issues.
 * Experience training, mentoring, or supporting other payroll team members
   preferred.
 * Intermediate to advanced Excel skills, including data analysis and
   reconciliations.
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 * Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and
   professionalism.

not limited to, processing payables weekly and monthly, reviewing and verifying
the accuracy of outstanding vendor and supplier invoices, researching and
resolving invoice discrepancies, and processing invoices for payment according
to policies and procedures. The Accounts Payable Clerk establishes and maintains
complex record and filing system of accounts payable vendor files.
